title: 635. Joan of Arc: For Fear of the Flames (Part 4)

sentences.en: Henry, by the grace of God, King of France and England, to all who will see this present letter, greeting.
sentences.zh: 亨利，蒙上帝恩典，法兰西与英格兰国王，致所有见此信函者，安好。

sentences.en: It is sufficiently notorious and well known how for some time past, a woman calling herself Joan the Maid abandoned women's clothes and dressed and armed herself like a man,
sentences.zh: 众所周知，前段时间，有一个自称“圣女”让娜的女子，抛弃了女性服饰，像男子一样穿着并武装自己，

sentences.en: a thing against divine law and abominable to God, and condemned and forbidden by every law.
sentences.zh: 此举违背神圣律法，为上帝所不容，且为一切法律所谴责和禁止。

sentences.en: She committed cruel murders, and as reported, seduced and abused simple people by trying to convince them that she was sent by God and knew heavenly secrets.
sentences.zh: 她犯下了残酷的谋杀罪，据报道，她通过诱导简单的人们相信她是上帝派遣的、知晓天国秘密的人，从而蛊惑并虐待了他们。

sentences.en: While fostering these deceptions and engaging in hostilities against us and our people, she was captured, fully armed,
sentences.zh: 在滋长这些欺骗行为并对我们及我方人民进行敌对活动的同时，她全副武装地被捕了，

sentences.en: by some of our loyal subjects, then brought to us as a prisoner.
sentences.zh: 被我们的一些忠实臣民俘获，随后作为囚犯被带到我们这里。

sentences.en: And because many have suspected and accused her of superstition, of spreading false dogmas, and of crimes of treason against divine
sentences.zh: 鉴于许多人怀疑并指控她迷信、传播虚假教条以及犯有违背神圣

sentences.en: majesty, we have been urgently entreated by the Reverend Father, our beloved and loyal counsellor,
sentences.zh: 尊严的叛国罪，我们受到尊贵的父亲、我们挚爱且忠诚的顾问的

sentences.en: the Bishop of Beauvais, to surrender Joan to the Reverend Father for questioning and examination,
sentences.zh: 博韦主教的紧急恳求，将让娜移交给尊贵的父亲进行讯问和审查，

sentences.en: so that after gathering a proper assembly, he can proceed against her according to the rules and regulations of divine and canon law.
sentences.zh: 以便在聚集适当的宗教会议后，他可以按照神圣法和教会法的规则和条例对她提起诉讼。

sentences.en: So that was a proclamation issued on the 3rd of January 1431, and it was issued in the name of the nine-year-old King of France, Henri II, Henry II, who is better
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一份于1431年1月3日发布的公告，它是以九岁法兰西国王亨利二世、亨利二世的名义发布的，他在英国更为人所知

sentences.en: known in England as King Henry VI.
sentences.zh: 的名字是英格兰国王亨利六世。

sentences.en: Now, Henry had arrived in France in April 1429, and three months later, he had made a ceremonial entry into Rouen, where, unfortunately, Tom, Henry had not impressed
sentences.zh: 现在，亨利于1429年4月抵达法兰西，三个月后，他举行了一场进入鲁昂的仪仗入城式，在那里，不幸的是，汤姆，亨利并没有给当地人留下深刻印象，

sentences.en: the locals, had he?
sentences.zh: 不是吗？

sentences.en: So we are in our final episode about Joan of Arc.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来到了关于圣女贞德的最后一集。

sentences.en: And let's start with Henry VI, the hero of this story in many ways.
sentences.zh: 让我们从亨利六世开始，在很多方面他是这个故事的主角。

sentences.en: So he had arrived, he's a little boy, he arrives in Rouen, and the French, sadly, don't really take to him, do they?
sentences.zh: 他抵达了，他还是个小男孩，他抵达了鲁昂，但遗憾的是，法国人并不怎么买他的账，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, so Henry VI is one of the great losers of English history.
sentences.zh: 嗯，亨利六世是英国历史上最大的失败者之一。

sentences.en: And I'm afraid that that kind of trend of being a loser begins early, because here he is, he's nine
sentences.zh: 恐怕那种作为失败者的趋势很早就开始了，因为他现在只有九岁，

sentences.en: years old, he's arrived in Rouen, and he does not impress people at all, because the crowds have turned out to cheer him.
sentences.zh: 他来到了鲁昂，却根本没有给人们留下好印象，因为人群本来是出来为他欢呼的。

sentences.en: And all he does is complain that they're making too much noise.
sentences.zh: 而他所做的只是抱怨他们制造的噪音太大了。

sentences.en: He then heads straight into the castle and basically refuses to leave it.
sentences.zh: 随后他直接径直走进城堡，基本上拒绝离开。

sentences.en: And by early January, when that edict that you read out is issued, he is still there.
sentences.zh: 到了1月上旬，当你念出的那份法令发布时，他依然待在那里。

sentences.en: He's this kind of nervous, very uncharismatic, effective, effectively invisible little boy.
sentences.zh: 他就是这种有些神经质、毫无个人魅力、实际上等同于隐形的小男孩。

sentences.en: And this is a huge problem for the English regime in France, because they really need Henry to, you know, work a bit of the old royal magic to
sentences.zh: 这对英国在法国的政权来说是一个巨大的问题，因为他们真的需要亨利去施展一点老一套的皇室魅力来

sentences.en: work the crowds, all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 讨好民众，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And Henry's simply refusing to play ball.
sentences.zh: 而亨利根本拒绝配合。

sentences.en: To be fair, he's nine years old.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，他才九岁。

sentences.en: So I mean, it is what people call a big ask.
sentences.zh: 所以我的意思是，这就是人们所说的强人所难。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I think you either have that, that sense for the stardust or you don't.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我觉得这种巨星般的吸引力要么天生就有，要么就没有。

sentences.en: And Henry doesn't.
sentences.zh: 而亨利没有。

sentences.en: Unlike his father, Henry V, who absolutely did.
sentences.zh: 不像他的父亲亨利五世，他绝对有。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, you have Henry, this nine-year-old little boy, cowering in the castle.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，你看到亨利这个九岁的小男孩，在城堡里瑟瑟发抖。

sentences.en: Now, on the other hand, you have a rival claimant to the throne of France, don't you?
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，你有一个法兰西王位的竞争对手，对吧？

sentences.en: Charles VII from the House of Valois, who for a few generations have been the royal dynasty of France.
sentences.zh: 来自瓦卢瓦王朝的查理七世，几代人以来他们一直是法兰西的皇室家族。

sentences.en: And Charles VII, having hitched his wagon to the star of Joan of Arc, has been crowned king in the great cathedral at Reims, which is where the Valois kings are traditionally
sentences.zh: 查理七世将自己的命运与圣女贞德绑定在一起，并在兰斯的宏伟大教堂加冕为王，瓦卢瓦国王传统上都在那里

sentences.en: crowned.
sentences.zh: 加冕。

sentences.en: And by doing that, he has wormed his way into the hearts and minds of his French compatriots.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他成功赢得了法国同胞的心灵与认可。

sentences.en: And actually, this is a big kind of psychological blow in the struggle between these two characters for the French throne, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 实际上，在争夺法兰西王位的这两个人物之间的斗争中，这是一个巨大的心理打击，不是吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And so the Duke of Bedford, who is Henry VI's regent in France, has decided, you know, there's nothing for it.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为亨利六世在法国的摄政王，贝德福德公爵决定，别无他法了。

sentences.en: We're going to have to have a coronation for Henry as well to try and blot out the memory of Charles VII's coronation.
sentences.zh: 我们也必须为亨利举行一次加冕典礼，以抹去查理七世加冕的记忆。

sentences.en: And this is why he has basically been brought to France.
sentences.zh: 这就是他基本上被带到法国的原因。

sentences.en: However, there's a problem with this plan, because Reims is still under the control of Charles VII.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个计划有个问题，因为兰斯仍然在查理七世的控制之下。

sentences.en: So it's inaccessible to Henry VI.
sentences.zh: 所以亨利六世无法到达那里。

sentences.en: He can't go there and be crowned.
sentences.zh: 他不能去那里加冕。

sentences.en: And Paris, which is the only conceivable alternative location for coronation, I think Bedford feels it's in a very febrile state.
sentences.zh: 至于巴黎，作为加冕典礼唯一可以想象的替代地点，贝德福德觉得那里的局势非常狂热动荡。

sentences.en: Again, it's too risky at the moment to take Henry VI there.
sentences.zh: 同样，现在把亨利六世带到那里风险太大了。

sentences.en: So the poor lad, I mean, he's useless, but you've got to feel for him.
sentences.zh: 所以这个可怜的孩子，我的意思是，他虽然没什么用，但你不得不为他感到同情。

sentences.en: He's stuck in Rouen.
sentences.zh: 他被困在了鲁昂。

sentences.en: It's an absolutely killing winter, completely bleak and freezing.
sentences.zh: 那是一个绝对要命的冬天，完全阴冷刺骨。

sentences.en: And he's stuck there waiting for a coronation that it seems might never come.
sentences.zh: 他被困在那里，等待着一场似乎永远不会到来的加冕礼。

sentences.en: So, you know, all in all, it's very unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 所以，总而言之，这非常不幸。

sentences.en: But this is not the only possible propaganda coup that the English have up their sleeves, is it?
sentences.zh: 但这并不是英国人手里唯一的宣传王牌，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it's important to them basically to undermine the legitimacy of Charles VII.
sentences.zh: 因为对他们来说，动摇查理七世的合法性基本上至关重要。

sentences.en: And if they can't get their own candidate into the cathedral to be crowned, one thing they
sentences.zh: 如果他们无法让自己的候选人进入大教堂加冕，他们能做的一件事

sentences.en: can do is to cast doubt on Charles VII's coronation by basically saying the person who has arranged
sentences.zh: 就是对查理七世的加冕提出质疑，方法基本上是说安排这一切的人、那个

sentences.en: all this, the person who lies, you know, at the heart of his regime is not privy to secrets from heaven through voices and angels.
sentences.zh: 处于他政权核心的人，并没有通过声音和天使获得来自天国的秘密。

sentences.en: But basically, as a witch, as a figure of darkness.
sentences.zh: 相反，她基本上是个女巫，一个黑暗的化身。

sentences.en: And this person is, of course, Joan the Maid, who we heard about in the introduction, Joan of Arc, because she's now fallen into English hands.
sentences.zh: 这个人当然就是我们在引言中听说的圣女让娜，即贞德，因为她现在落入了英国人的手中。

sentences.en: She has.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: She's been sold by a Burgundian nobleman to the English.
sentences.zh: 她被一个勃艮第贵族卖给了英国人。

sentences.en: And she's, we heard at the end of the previous episode, that she'd arrived in Rouen on the 23rd of December, 1430.
sentences.zh: 我们在上一集的结尾听说过，她于1430年12月23日抵达了鲁昂。

sentences.en: And she had been handed over to the guy who is the current captain of the castle in Rouen.
sentences.zh: 她被移交给了当时鲁昂城堡的指挥官。

sentences.en: And this is a very formidable man, a guy who makes a very formidable jailer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常令人生畏的人，一个极其可怕的狱卒。

sentences.en: He is Richard Beauchamp, the Earl of Warwick.
sentences.zh: 他就是沃里克伯爵理查德·博尚。

sentences.en: And he had been a very close friend of Henry V's.
sentences.zh: 他曾是亨利五世的密友。

sentences.en: Henry V wasn't a guy given to friendship, but he liked
sentences.zh: 亨利五世并不是一个轻易交朋友的人，但他喜欢

sentences.en: Warwick.
sentences.zh: 沃里克。

sentences.en: And Warwick therefore feels a kind of personal responsibility, I think, to Henry VI, and had arrived in France, essentially at the head of the young king's escort.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃里克对亨利六世有一种个人责任感，我想，他基本上率领着年轻国王的护卫队抵达了法兰西。

sentences.en: And in the words of a contemporary, he was a man of impressive bearing, exceptional judgment, and great military experience.
sentences.zh: 用当代人的话说，他是一个风度翩翩、判断力非凡、具有丰富军事经验的人。

sentences.en: And as such, he perfectly understands the urgent need to make an international spectacle of Joan's trial.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他完全理解将贞德的审判办成一场国际奇观的迫切需要。

sentences.en: He knows that this has to be done on the stage of not just France, but of the whole of
sentences.zh: 他知道这不仅要在法国的舞台上进行，还要在全欧洲

sentences.en: Christendom.
sentences.zh: 基督教世界的舞台上进行。

sentences.en: But if that's going to happen, he has to keep a tight leash on her.
sentences.zh: 但如果这一切要发生，他就必须严加看管她。

sentences.en: Because she's already tried to escape, hasn't she?
sentences.zh: 因为她已经试图逃跑过了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Twice.
sentences.zh: 两次。

sentences.en: And the second time, if I remember correctly, she jumped out of a 60-foot tower and basically only damaged her back or something.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，第二次她从一座六十英尺高的塔上跳了下来，基本上只是伤到了背部之类的。

sentences.en: Got very badly concussed.
sentences.zh: 受到了严重的脑震荡。

sentences.en: I mean, yeah, I'm not entirely sure.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，我不是完全确定。

sentences.en: And this is the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 而且这是中世纪。

sentences.en: So
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: I'm not, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不是，我不知道。

sentences.en: But Warwick is not going to let anything like that happen on his watch.
sentences.zh: 但沃里克绝不会在自己的眼皮底下让这种事发生。

sentences.en: So the moment Joan has arrived in Rouen, she's taken straight to the city's castle, which is the absolute nerve center of English rule, not just in Normandy, but probably now by
sentences.zh: 所以让娜一到达鲁昂，就被直接带到了这座城市的城堡，这里是英国统治的绝对核心，不仅在诺曼底，现在可能在整个

sentences.en: France, because Paris has become so unstable.
sentences.zh: 法兰西也是如此，因为巴黎已经变得极不稳定。

sentences.en: And of course, it's the very place where Henry VI is staying.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是亨利六世居住的地方。

sentences.en: But Joan's quarters are obviously much less luxurious than the king's.
sentences.zh: 但让娜的住处显然远不如国王的豪华。

sentences.en: She is immured in a large, cold, unfurnished cell in one of the towers of the castle.
sentences.zh: 她被关在城堡其中一座塔楼里一个巨大、寒冷、陈设简陋的牢房里。

sentences.en: And it only has two very narrow arrow slits to let in the light.
sentences.zh: 里面只有两个非常狭窄的箭狭缝用来透光。

sentences.en: So it's a very kind of grim place to be kept.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个关押起来非常严酷的地方。

sentences.en: And in this cell, she is shackled by her ankles to a huge wooden beam.
sentences.zh: 在这个牢房里，她的脚踝被一副大木梁上的镣铐锁住。

sentences.en: There are four English guards on rotation, keeping watch over her day and night.
sentences.zh: 有四名英国卫兵轮流日夜监视着她。

sentences.en: And Warwick forbids anyone to talk to her without permission.
sentences.zh: 沃里克禁止任何人未经许可与她交谈。

sentences.en: So she, you know, she is absolutely not, for instance, getting any legal advice.
sentences.zh: 所以她，你知道的，绝对没有获得任何法律咨询之类的途径。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this point about legal advice is important, of course, because the English authorities
sentences.zh: 关于法律咨询这一点很重要，当然，因为英国当局

sentences.en: from the outset are determined that she will go on trial, she will be convicted, and she will be put to death.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就决心让她受审、将她定罪并处以死刑。

sentences.en: And this, as we discussed last time, is not purely a question of kind of cynical policy.
sentences.zh: 正如我们上次讨论的那样，这并非纯粹出于某种冷酷的政治策略。

sentences.en: They genuinely believe that she is a witch and that she represents something diabolical, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们真心相信她是一个女巫，代表着某种魔鬼般的力量，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think Bedford especially does, and Warwick does as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我觉得贝德福德尤其是这样，沃里克也是。

sentences.en: And this sense that they are dealing perhaps with satanic powers is one of the factors that has influenced them in agreeing
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己可能是在与撒旦的力量打交道，这种感觉是促使他们同意

sentences.en: to outsource legal proceedings to the ecclesiastical authorities.
sentences.zh: 将法律诉讼外包给教会当局的因素之一。

sentences.en: And specifically, as we heard in the edict that you read out from, issued in the name of Henry VI, she is going to be transferred for trial
sentences.zh: 具体来说，正如我们在你宣读的以亨利六世名义发布的法令中所听到的那样，她将被移交给

sentences.en: to the Bishop of the Sea in which Joan had first been taken prisoner.
sentences.zh: 让娜最初被俘时所在教区的主教受审。

sentences.en: So to quote that edict, our beloved and loyal counsellor, the Bishop of Beauvais.
sentences.zh: 引述那份法令的话说，即我们挚爱且忠诚的顾问、博韦主教。

sentences.en: And this is a guy we've heard of before,
sentences.zh: 这就是我们以前听说过的一个人，

sentences.en: Pierre Cauchon.
sentences.zh: 皮埃尔·科雄。

sentences.en: So Pierre Cauchon is going to preside over this.
sentences.zh: 所以皮埃尔·科雄将主持这场审判。

sentences.en: It's important to say, isn't it, it's not a trial as we would understand it.
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，这不是我们所理解的那种审判，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, people aren't shouting, objection, your honour, and all of this kind of carry on.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们不会大喊“反对，法官大人”以及诸如此类的戏码。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's no jury or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，没有陪审团之类的东西。

sentences.en: No, this is an ecclesiastical court, and it is literally an inquisition, an investigation into suspected heresy.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一个宗教法庭，实际上是一场审讯，是对疑似异端的调查。

sentences.en: And we'll talk us through some of the procedure, because the procedure has been established over the last couple of centuries, hasn't it?
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲其中的一些程序吧，因为这些程序在过去几个世纪里已经建立起来了，对吧？

sentences.en: And this isn't necessarily a show trial.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是一场表演性审判。

sentences.en: I mean, people take this stuff very seriously.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们对这些事情非常认真。

sentences.en: Yeah, and there's a very precise format by now for inquisitions.
sentences.zh: 是的，目前对于审讯已经有了一个非常精确的程式。

sentences.en: So the initial responsibility of the judges, Cauchon is one, they are also in due course going to recruit a local head of the
sentences.zh: 因此，法官们的最初责任——科雄是其中一位，他们随后还将招募当地一位

sentences.en: Dominican prior to be the second judge.
sentences.zh: 多米尼加修道院院长担任第二位法官。

sentences.en: Their responsibility is clear.
sentences.zh: 他们的责任很明确。

sentences.en: They have to establish that
sentences.zh: 他们必须确立

sentences.en: the person who is going to be sent to trial has a reputation so shocking, so pestiferous, that it positively demands to be investigated.
sentences.zh: 即将被送上审判的人名声如此骇人、如此具有毒害性，以至于它绝对需要被调查。

sentences.en: And in the case of Joan, this is seen as being a very simple matter, because she, by this point, has become easily the most famous woman in
sentences.zh: 就让娜而言，这被认为是一件很简单的事情，因为到这个时候，她已经成为了基督教世界里

sentences.en: Christendom, perhaps, you know, the most famous person full stop.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问最著名的女性，也许可以说是最有名的人。

sentences.en: So to quote a German theologian contemporary, such wonders Joan has performed that not just France, but every Christian kingdom stands amazed.
sentences.zh: 借用一位德国当代神学家的话说，让娜所创造的奇迹如此之多，以至于不仅是法兰西，每一个基督教王国都为之震惊。

sentences.en: So this trial is going to be massive news, whatever happens.
sentences.zh: 所以无论发生什么，这场审判都将成为重磅新闻。

sentences.en: But it also means that on the 9th of January, when Cauchon indicts Joan as a woman of what he calls Marla
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着，在1月9日，当科雄指控让娜是一个他所谓的名誉扫地

sentences.en: Farmer, so notoriety, he can take it as read that everyone knows what she's done.
sentences.zh: 的女子时，他可以认为每个人都知道她做了什么，这是不证自明的。

sentences.en: He doesn't have to kind of adduce it.
sentences.zh: 他不必去引用证明。

sentences.en: He doesn't have to justify it.
sentences.zh: 他不必为之辩护。

sentences.en: And he draws up two particular accounts of heretical behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他列出了两项具体的异端行为指控。

sentences.en: The first is, to quote the charge sheet, that Joan had dared to perform, to speak, and to publicise many things contrary to the Catholic faith, and injurious to its articles.
sentences.zh: 第一项是，引用起诉书的话说，让娜胆敢做出、说出并宣扬许多违背天主教信仰且损害其教义的事情。

sentences.en: Secondly, that utterly disregarding the honour due to the female sex, throwing off the bridle of modesty,
sentences.zh: 其次，她完全无视女性应有的尊誉，挣脱了谦逊的缰绳，

sentences.en: and forgetting all female decency, she wore the disgraceful clothing of men, a shocking and vile monstrosity.
sentences.zh: 忘却了所有女性的体统，竟然穿上了男性的耻辱服装，这是一种令人震惊且卑劣的畸形怪状。

sentences.en: And these two trials signal what, over the course of Joan's trial, are going to be the main focus of Cauchon's investigations.
sentences.zh: 这两项审判标志着在让娜的审判过程中，科雄调查的主要焦点。

sentences.en: So specifically, the truth or otherwise of Joan's claims to have received direct communication from the heavens.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，就是让娜声称自己直接接收到来自天堂的信息这一说法的真实与否。

sentences.en: So in other words, the validity or otherwise of her voices.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是她的声音的有效性与否。

sentences.en: And secondly, what Cauchon sees as her absolutely mulish insistence on wearing male dress, which is directly contrary to biblical injunctions.
sentences.zh: 其次，在科雄看来，她顽固不化地坚持穿男装，这直接违背了圣经的戒命。

sentences.en: It's interesting that that issue about male dress looms so large, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，关于男装的问题显得如此重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: For reasons that we'll come to in the course of the trial.
sentences.zh: 原因我们会在审判过程中谈到。

sentences.en: So before that, Cauchon has to pile up all of this evidence and all of these documents and stuff.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，科雄必须堆积起所有这些证据、所有这些文件之类的信息。

sentences.en: And this goes to the point about whether or not this is just a show trial by a kangaroo court.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一个问题，即这是否只是一场袋鼠法庭操纵的表演性审判。

sentences.en: And I believe a lot of scholars now argue that that's to do it an injustice, that actually this is a much more serious and painstaking proceeding than is popularly imagined.
sentences.zh: 我相信现在很多学者认为这种看法对审判不公，实际上这是一个比人们想象的要严肃和细致得多得多的诉讼程序。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, and not just popularly imagined, but than is normal in an inquisition.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不仅是人们想象的，而且比一般的审讯更甚。

sentences.en: It is incredibly detailed and forensic.
sentences.zh: 它是极其详细和严密的法医式的。

sentences.en: So to quote Daniel Hobbins, who published this translation of all the documents relating to
sentences.zh: 引用丹尼尔·霍宾斯的话，他将所有与

sentences.en: Joan's trial into English, and he emphasizes in his introduction to that collection, the degree to which
sentences.zh: 让娜审判相关的文件翻译成了英文，并在该书集的引言中强调了

sentences.en: Cauchon is not, you know, he is not trampling on the recognized procedures in an inquisition.
sentences.zh: 科雄并非在践踏审讯中公认的程序的程度。

sentences.en: Absolutely on the contrary, he is going to inordinate pains to ensure that the rules are very, very strictly followed.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，他费尽心机，确保所有规则都得到极其严格的执行。

sentences.en: And this is why we have all the many documents that we do relating to Joan's trial.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么我们有那么多关于审判贞德的档案文件。

sentences.en: To quote Hobbins, Cauchon believed his role in the trial would bear examination from even hostile observers.
sentences.zh: 用霍宾斯的话说，科雄相信他在审判中的角色经得起最敌对的观察者的检验。

sentences.en: And because he knows that, you know, there is, we've said there's going to be massive, massive international interest in the, in this case, that's the whole point of doing it.
sentences.zh: 正因为他知道——你知道的——我们说过，国际社会对这个案件将会产生巨大的、海量的关注，这才是这样做的全部意义所在。

sentences.en: So he knows that he can't afford to cut corners because otherwise he will get criticism.
sentences.zh: 所以他知道自己绝不能偷工减料，否则他会招致批评。

sentences.en: Everything has to be done precisely by the book.
sentences.zh: 一切都必须严格按照规章制度来办。

sentences.en: And so this is why, even though Cauchon had indicted Joan on the 9th of January, he then spends about six weeks making sure that everything is in absolutely perfect order
sentences.zh: 正因如此，尽管科雄在1月9日就对贞德提出了起诉，但他还是花了大约六周时间来确保一切都绝对万无一失

sentences.en: before the trial itself actually begins.
sentences.zh: 在审判正式开始之前。

sentences.en: So they send investigators, don't they, to Joan's home village of Don Rémy, which is a difficult task because, as we discussed, it's a liminal space.
sentences.zh: 所以他们派了调查人员去贞德的家乡栋勒米，对吧？这是一项艰难的任务，正如我们讨论过的，那是一个边缘地带。

sentences.en: It was full of bandits and it's now full of French, basically.
sentences.zh: 那里到处都是土匪，而且基本上现在全都是法国人了。

sentences.en: So it's a dangerous place for, for his investigators to go.
sentences.zh: 所以对他的调查人员来说，那是一个危险的地方。

sentences.en: And, and poor Joan has been subject to a lot of physical examinations.
sentences.zh: 而且，可怜的贞德已经接受了许多次身体检查。

sentences.en: And now she has yet another one by the Duke of Bedford's wife, the Duchess of Bedford, to check again, whether she is a virgin or not.
sentences.zh: 现在她又接受了贝德福德公爵夫人的另一次检查，以再次确认她是否还是处女。

sentences.en: And she still is.
sentences.zh: 而她确实仍然是。

sentences.en: So she passes that test at any rate.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何她通过了那项测试。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, Cauchon is drawing up all of these lists of questions and stuff, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，科雄正在拟定所有这些问题清单之类的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: And he's hiring people.
sentences.zh: 而且他在招募人手。

sentences.en: So officials and inquisitors and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 比如官员、宗教裁判官之类的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So a huge number of advisors, assessors, examiners, theologians, expert witnesses, all these kind of people are being lined up.
sentences.zh: 所以有大量的顾问、陪审员、审查官、神学家、专家证人，所有这类人都在排队等候。

sentences.en: And in fact, over the course of the trial, 131 lawyers, theologians, priests, abbots end up participating in it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在整个审判过程中，最终有131名律师、神学家、牧师和修道院院长参与其中。

sentences.en: And the kind of amazing fact for people who think that this is an English kangaroo court, all but eight of these 131 figures are French.
sentences.zh: 对于那些认为这是一场英国袋鼠法庭审判的人来说，一个惊人的事实是，在这131个人中，除了8个人之外，其余全都是法国人。

sentences.en: That's so surprising.
sentences.zh: 真是令人意外。

sentences.en: And of those eight, only three are English.
sentences.zh: 在这8个人中，只有3个是英国人。

sentences.en: It's a lawyer and two theologians from Oxford.
sentences.zh: 是一名律师和两名来自牛津的神学家。

sentences.en: Now, that really is a twist, because I'd always assumed this was a completely English-run affair.
sentences.zh: 这可真是一个大反转，因为我一直以为这是一场完全由英国人主导的事情。

sentences.en: And actually, but these are French people who are, they're part of Henry VI's party, his faction, as it were.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这些人是法国人，他们是亨利六世党人，可以说是他的派系成员。

sentences.en: Are they?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: All loyal to the Burgundians.
sentences.zh: 全都忠于勃艮第派。

sentences.en: They genuinely think that Henry is appointed by God.
sentences.zh: 他们真心认为亨利是上帝指定的。

sentences.en: They accept the Treaty of Troyes.
sentences.zh: 他们接受了《特鲁瓦条约》。

sentences.en: They think that Charles VII is an imposter, a usurper.
sentences.zh: 他们认为查理七世是个冒牌货、篡位者。

sentences.en: So they are all in.
sentences.zh: 所以他们全身心投入。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, they send out tremendous people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们派出了了不起的人。

sentences.en: So the 20th of February, Cochon is ready and he delivers this formal summons to Joan, telling her, you have to appeal before the tribunal the following day.
sentences.zh: 所以在2月20日，科雄准备就绪，他向贞德送达了正式传票，告诉她：你必须在第二天出庭受审。

sentences.en: And so at eight o'clock on the morning, the 21st of February, this very dramatic day begins.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2月21日清晨八点，这个极具戏剧性的一天开始了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Joan is led down from her cell up in the tower and she's led out into a courtyard and taken to the chapel of the castle in Rouen.
sentences.zh: 于是贞德被带出了位于塔楼上的牢房，带到一个庭院里，并被带到了鲁昂城堡的礼拜堂。

sentences.en: And this is where Cochon and the assessors are gathered.
sentences.zh: 这就是科雄和陪审团成员聚集的地方。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, we've said how the apparatus of this trial isn't very
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，我们说过这场审判的机构设置并不是很

sentences.en: French, but the security is definitely provided by the English.
sentences.zh: 法国化，但安保工作绝对是由英国人提供的。

sentences.en: So there are English guards everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以到处都是英国警卫。

sentences.en: And the Earl of Warwick is a kind of constant lurking presence in the background.
sentences.zh: 而沃里克伯爵则像是一个在背景中不断潜伏的存在。

sentences.en: He is definitely keeping an eye on proceedings.
sentences.zh: 他绝对在密切关注着诉讼程序。

sentences.en: So Joan is brought in for her trial.
sentences.zh: 于是贞德被带进来受审。

sentences.en: She is still dressed in male clothes.
sentences.zh: 她依然穿着男装。

sentences.en: Her dark hair is still cropped short.
sentences.zh: 她的黑发依然剪得很短。

sentences.en: And although obviously she hasn't been getting much sunlight because her cell only has those two arrow slits, she impresses people, I think, with her, her bearing.
sentences.zh: 尽管显然她没有接受多少阳光照射，因为她的牢房只有那两个箭缝，但我认为她的风度给人们留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: She looks resolute.
sentences.zh: 她看起来坚定不移。

sentences.en: She looks unbowed.
sentences.zh: 她看起来毫不屈服。

sentences.en: But you know, she's a teenage girl and she is being brought into this room full of men, all of whom are much older than her.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，她只是个十几岁的女孩，却被带进这个满是男人的房间里，这些人全都比她年长得多。

sentences.en: And of course, who are infinitely her superiors in learning.
sentences.zh: 而且当然，在学识上他们比她优秀无数倍。

sentences.en: So Joan, you know, we've said she was raised a peasant.
sentences.zh: 所以贞德，你知道的，我们说过她是在农民家庭中长大的。

sentences.en: She's illiterate.
sentences.zh: 她是文盲。

sentences.en: She has no expertise in theology.
sentences.zh: 她没有任何神学方面的专业知识。

sentences.en: She has no familiarity with the kind of moral and metaphysical terms that her judges and her assessors are going to be bandying around.
sentences.zh: 她不熟悉她的法官和陪审员们将要随口说出的那些道德和形而上学术语。

sentences.en: And she has no real understanding of the legal procedures in which she is now ensnared.
sentences.zh: 她对她现在深陷其中的法律程序也没有真正的理解。

sentences.en: She has the vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 她有词汇量。

sentences.en: She has the modes of expression of a peasant, a very smart, intelligent, often sassy peasant.
sentences.zh: 她拥有农民的表达方式——一个非常聪明、机敏、常常伶牙俐齿的农民。

sentences.en: But, you know, she is not a scholar from the University of Paris.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，她不是巴黎大学的学者。

sentences.en: And these are the, you know, the guys that she is facing.
sentences.zh: 而这些就是，你知道的，她所面对的家伙们。

sentences.en: And I think it is an incredibly
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个令人难以置信的

sentences.en: Kafkaesque environment because, you know, we've said she doesn't have a defence lawyer.
sentences.zh: 卡夫卡式的环境，因为，你知道的，我们说过她没有辩护律师。

sentences.en: She's going to have to effectively conduct her own defence.
sentences.zh: 她实际上不得不自己为自己辩护。

sentences.en: She has all these kind of guys who are large numbers of people who are just firing questions at her.
sentences.zh: 她周围有这么大一群人，只是在向她抛出一个个问题。

sentences.en: There's never a single topic.
sentences.zh: 从来没有一个单一的主题。

sentences.en: They're always coming at her at different angles.
sentences.zh: 他们总是从不同的角度向她逼问。

sentences.en: There isn't any continuity of the personnel.
sentences.zh: 人员没有任何连续性。

sentences.en: You know, one judge will be there one day, gone the next.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一个法官今天还在，明天就走了。

sentences.en: I mean, incredibly bewildering for her, I think, and intimidating.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这给她带来了难以置信的困惑和恐吓。

sentences.en: But right from the start, she displays an astonishing degree of self-possession of spirit.
sentences.zh: 但从一开始，她就表现出惊人的沉着和精神力量。

sentences.en: And to read the trial proceedings, I think it is impossible not to be incredibly impressed by her.
sentences.zh: 读审判记录时，我想不可能不被她深深打动。

sentences.en: So, it starts by, Cochon tells her, you must swear an oath on the Gospels to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 所以，审判开始了，科雄告诉她：你必须按着福音书发誓说实话。

sentences.en: And she kind of lays down a marker right from the beginning, doesn't she?
sentences.zh: 她从一开始就表明了自己的态度，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because she says,
sentences.zh: 因为她说，

sentences.en: I don't know what you wish to ask me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们想问我什么。

sentences.en: Perhaps you might ask me things I can't tell you.
sentences.zh: 也许你们会问我一些我无法告诉你们的事。

sentences.en: So, what are these things that she can't tell him?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些她无法告诉他们的事情是什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, there's a number of things, but absolutely top of the list is her voices.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多事情，但绝对排在榜首的是她的声音。

sentences.en: And she tells Cochon,
sentences.zh: 她告诉科雄：

sentences.en: I'm very happy to answer questions about my parents or about everything that I've been doing since I left their house.
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意回答关于我的父母，或者关于我离开家之后所做的一切事情的问题。

sentences.en: But, and to quote her, the revelations to her from God as she defined those voices, she is saying, you know, that's a different matter.
sentences.zh: 但是，引用她的话说，上帝对她的启示——正如她对这些声音的定义——她说，你知道的，那是另一回事。

sentences.en: They are off limits.
sentences.zh: 这些是禁区。

sentences.en: And she goes on to explain that she had only ever talked about these voices to Charles VII.
sentences.zh: 她接着解释说，她只对查理七世谈论过这些声音。

sentences.en: And she doesn't believe that she is permitted by heaven to discuss them.
sentences.zh: 而且她认为天堂不允许她讨论这些。

sentences.en: And she specifies, you know, I am not allowed to talk about them, even were it necessary to cut off my head.
sentences.zh: 她具体说道：你知道的，不允许我谈论它们，哪怕是要砍掉我的头也一样。

sentences.en: And she then tells Cochon, you know, but I might be able to in eight days' time.
sentences.zh: 然后她告诉科雄：不过我可能在八天后会说。

sentences.en: What's happening in eight days' time?
sentences.zh: 八天后会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's obviously a number that she's kind of snatching from the void.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这显然是她凭空捏造的一个数字。

sentences.en: The voices have promised to get back to her by eight days.
sentences.zh: 声音答应在八天内回复她。

sentences.en: Yeah, the voices will get back to her.
sentences.zh: 对，声音会联系她的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And Cochon had not been expecting this, but, you know, he's not having any of it.
sentences.zh: 科雄没有料到这一点，但是，你知道的，他可不吃这一套。

sentences.en: And in the days that follow, he and the assessors are just harrying and chivvying Joan relentlessly to try and force her to talk about the voices.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几天里，他和陪审员们对贞德进行了无休止的盘问和纠缠，试图迫使她谈论那些声音。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Joan adopts different tactics, doesn't she, to keep the inquisitors at bay.
sentences.zh: 所以贞德采取了不同的策略，来把宗教裁判官们拒之门外，对吧？

sentences.en: So one of them, nice cricketing metaphor for you, Tom, she plays a dead bat.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，其中一个策略——给你用个板球的好比喻——她采取了稳守不出的策略（plays a dead bat）。

sentences.en: Next question.
sentences.zh: 下一个问题。

sentences.en: Often she says, certainly at the beginning, she says this thing, you know, this is just between me and God.
sentences.zh: 她经常说，至少在开始时她会这么说，你知道的，这是我和上帝之间的事。

sentences.en: I'm not going to tell you everything for I don't have permission.
sentences.zh: 我不会把一切都告诉你们，因为我没有得到允许。

sentences.en: But then she changes the strategy at times, doesn't she?
sentences.zh: 但有时她又会改变策略，对吧？

sentences.en: She talks, she says, well, you need to talk to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 她会说，好吧，你们得去跟其他人谈谈。

sentences.en: You need to talk to the scholars who investigated me in Poitiers.
sentences.zh: 你们得去跟那些在普瓦捷调查过我的人谈谈。

sentences.en: Remember we talked about that when it was sort of like a kind of viva she had by Charles VII's churchman.
sentences.zh: 还记得我们讨论过的那次吗？就像是查理七世的神职人员对她进行的一次答辩考试。

sentences.en: And there's such a kind of touching degree of naivety to that, to imagine that the scholars in English Rouen would ever go and consult the scholars in Valois Poitiers.
sentences.zh: 这种想法有一种感人至深的幼稚，竟然想象英国鲁昂的学者会去咨询瓦卢瓦普瓦捷的学者。

sentences.en: You know, it's kind of a reminder that she doesn't entirely have a handle on the politics of it all, I think.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这在一定程度上提醒我们，她并没有完全掌控这一切背后的政治。

sentences.en: And also, I mean, having said that she's not absolutely got her finger on the pulse of the politics.
sentences.zh: 而且，话说回来，虽然她没有完全把准政治的脉搏。

sentences.en: I mean, she does have this incredible kind of earthy common sense of a peasant.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她确实有一种农民那种不可思议的朴素常识。

sentences.en: If you were a 19th century historian, you'd call it, you know, but she, you know, she's kind of being badgered by Koshaw and said, you've got to tell us everything.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个19世纪的历史学家，你可能会称之为……但她，你知道的，她正被科雄纠缠不休，对方说：你必须把一切都告诉我们。

sentences.en: And she responds as a saying among little children that people are often hanged for telling the truth, you know, and she's, she's not wrong there.
sentences.zh: 她回应说，小孩子当中流传着一句俗语，说人们常常因为说实话而被绞死，你知道的，她这话可没说错。

sentences.en: But basically there are 15 sessions of interrogation and they are exhausting and they are kind of merciless.
sentences.zh: 但基本上有15次审讯，它们令人精疲力竭，而且毫不留情。

sentences.en: And over time she begins to concede more and more ground.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她开始做出越来越多的退让。

sentences.en: She does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So already by the second session, so remember in the first session, she said,
sentences.zh: 所以在第二次审讯时——记住，在第一次审讯时，她曾说，

sentences.en: I'm not going to talk about voices by the second session.
sentences.zh: 我不会谈论那些声音——到了第二次审讯时。

sentences.en: She's already doing that.
sentences.zh: 她就已经这么做了。

sentences.en: She's starting to talk about how she first heard them, um, how she'd known that it was an angel speaking to her.
sentences.zh: 她开始谈论她是如何第一次听到这些声音的，嗯，她是如何知道是一个天使在对她说话的。

sentences.en: So all the details that we mentioned in our first episode, describing how Joan came to hear the voices, the first, it back in Domremy, this is where those details come from.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在第一集里提到的所有细节，都描述了贞德是如何听到这些声音的，最早是在栋勒米，这些细节就是从这里来的。

sentences.en: And then in the third session, she reveals that the voice is still very much a presence.
sentences.zh: 然后在第三次审讯中，她透露这个声音依然真实存在。

sentences.en: It's still very much with her.
sentences.zh: 它依然紧紧伴随着她。

sentences.en: So she tells Koshaw and, and the rest of the court that she had heard the voice three times the previous day.
sentences.zh: 于是她告诉科雄和法庭上的其他人，前一天她听到那个声音三次。

sentences.en: And she specifies once in the morning, once at Vespers and the third time when the bell rang for the Hail Mary at night.
sentences.zh: 她具体说明了：一次在早晨，一次在晚祷时，第三次是在夜晚为圣母颂敲响钟声的时候。

sentences.en: And people may remember that the very first time back in Domremy, when she heard the ringing of bells, she reveals that the voice had woken her up in
sentences.zh: 人们可能还记得，早在栋勒米第一次听到钟声时，她就透露那个声音曾在

sentences.en: the morning while she lay sleeping.
sentences.zh: 早晨她躺着睡觉时将她唤醒。

sentences.en: And she also says that she had asked it for, uh, its advice on how best to deal with her interrogators.
sentences.zh: 她还说，她曾向它征求过建议，询问如何应对审讯人员才是最好的办法。

sentences.en: And she says, the voice told me to answer boldly and God would help me.
sentences.zh: 她说，声音告诉我要大胆回答，上帝会帮助我。

sentences.en: And then in the fourth session, so that was the third session in the fourth session, we get a real bombshell, don't we?
sentences.zh: 然后在第四次审讯中——那是第三次审讯，在第四次审讯中，我们迎来了一个真正的重磅炸弹，对吧？

sentences.en: Because for the first time she says, I know where the voice comes from.
sentences.zh: 因为她第一次说道：我知道声音来自哪里。

sentences.en: I know what the voice is.
sentences.zh: 我知道声音是什么。

sentences.en: It is the voice of St. Catherine and St. Margaret and their forms are crowned with beautiful crowns in rich and precious fashion.
sentences.zh: 那是圣凯瑟琳和圣玛格丽特的声音，她们的头上戴着用珍贵华丽方式制作的美丽皇冠。

sentences.en: So remind listeners, Tom, St. Catherine of Catherine
sentences.zh: 所以汤姆，提醒一下听众，以凯瑟琳

sentences.en: Wheel firework fame had been martyred, but for refusing to surrender her virginity.
sentences.zh: 轮烟花闻名的圣凯瑟琳因拒绝放弃贞洁而殉道。

sentences.en: And St. Margaret, exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 圣玛格丽特也是完全一样。

sentences.en: And a further detail, St. Margaret had been so fired with the love of the gospel that she had dressed up as a man to smuggle herself into a monastery.
sentences.zh: 还有一个细节，圣玛格丽特对福音的热爱如此炽热，以至于她穿上男装，把自己偷运进了一座修道院。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Very, yeah.
sentences.zh: 非常，是的。

sentences.en: Very suggestive.
sentences.zh: 非常耐人寻味。

sentences.en: So there's an emphasis there on virginity and on cross-dressing, which people may feel is perhaps psychologically significant.
sentences.zh: 因此这里强调了贞洁和反串着装，人们可能会觉得这在心理学上具有某种意义。

sentences.en: Um, and then shortly after that bombshell, there's another bombshell because she, um, describes again in detail the very first time she heard the voice back in Don
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在那个重磅炸弹爆出后不久，又出现了一个重磅炸弹，因为她，嗯，又详细描述了她在栋

sentences.en: Rémy.
sentences.zh: 勒米第一次听到声音的情形。

sentences.en: And she reveals who precisely had been behind that voice to quote her.
sentences.zh: 并且她透露了究竟是谁在那个声音的背后，引用她的话说：

sentences.en: I saw St. Michael before my eyes and he was not alone, but was well attended by angels from heaven.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼看到了圣迈克尔，他不是一个人，身旁还有许多来自天堂的天使随行。

sentences.en: So St. Michael, the captain, the archangel, uh, who is the captain of heaven, the great patron of French resistance to the English.
sentences.zh: 所以圣迈克尔，这位统帅，大天使，嗯，他是天堂的统帅，是法国人抵抗英国人的伟大守护神。

sentences.en: It's St. Michael also who had spoken to her.
sentences.zh: 也是圣迈克尔对她说过话。

sentences.en: So you've got St. Catherine, St. Margaret,
sentences.zh: 所以你有圣凯瑟琳、圣玛格丽特、

sentences.en: St. Michael.
sentences.zh: 圣迈克尔。

sentences.en: So you mentioned the great historian Johann Hausinger and this argument that basically this
sentences.zh: 你提到了伟大的历史学家约翰·豪辛格，以及这样一个观点：基本上

sentences.en: is the first time it's occurred to her who the voices are that previously she didn't know.
sentences.zh: 这是她第一次意识到这些声音究竟是谁，而此前她并不知道。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So to quote Hausinger, it seems plausible to me that it was only fairly late, perhaps even only during her trial that Joan linked her inspirations to the figures she knew best and
sentences.zh: 所以引用豪辛格的话来说，在我看来，很可能直到相当晚的时候，甚至可能直到受审期间，圣女贞德才将她的神启

sentences.en: cherished most among the saints.
sentences.zh: 与她最熟悉、最珍视的圣徒联系起来。

sentences.en: And so these saints, you know, she would have viewed them almost as her intimates.
sentences.zh: 所以这些圣徒，你知道的，她会把他们看作是自己最亲密的人。

sentences.en: And I guess what Hausinger is suggesting is that under the pressure of this interrogation, she reaches for these saints almost as metaphors for the voices.
sentences.zh: 我想豪辛格的意思是，在审讯的压力下，她几乎是把这些圣徒当作声音的隐喻来抓取。

sentences.en: You know, she is being harried and harried and harried, and she's desperate to try and put into words to explain to
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她一次又一次地遭到盘问，她极力想要用言语向

sentences.en: her inquisitors what the voices mean to her, why she loves them, why she trusts them, why these voices bring her consolation.
sentences.zh: 审讯官们解释这些声音对意味着什么，为什么她爱他们，为什么她信任他们，为什么这些声音能给她带来慰藉。

sentences.en: And so she turns to the saints that she loved beSt. And I think that what you get in this testimony from Joan is a sense that she is trying to understand what she's been having.
sentences.zh: 于是她转向了她最挚爱的圣徒。我认为从贞德的这些证词中，你能感觉到她正在试图理解自己一直在经历的事情。

sentences.en: And definitely her inquisitors are struggling to understand as well, because there is a real sense in
sentences.zh: 而且她的审讯官们显然也在努力理解，因为从某种真正的意义上说

sentences.en: which what Joan's testimony reveals is an experience of the supernatural that is fundamentally unlike most
sentences.zh: 贞德的证词所揭示的超自然体验，与大多数其他预言家、

sentences.en: other testimonies from visionaries, from people who claim to have heard or witnessed the saints.
sentences.zh: 声称听到或目睹过圣徒之人的证词有着根本的不同。

sentences.en: So like Catherine of Siena, who we mentioned before.
sentences.zh: 就像我们之前提到过的锡耶纳的凯瑟琳一样。

sentences.en: So it's not like that.
sentences.zh: 所以它不是那样的。

sentences.en: It's different.
sentences.zh: 它是不同的。

sentences.en: It's more, more earthy, more concrete, more...
sentences.zh: 它更接地气，更具体，更……

sentences.en: Less abstract, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，更不抽象。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Joan is not a girl for abstractions.
sentences.zh: 贞德可不是一个喜欢抽象概念的女孩。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, Joan is absolutely convinced that her voices do come from heavenly entities, that they are independent of her, that they are exterior of her,
sentences.zh: 一方面，贞德坚信她的声音确实来自天上的实体，它们独立于她，存在于她的体外，

sentences.en: that, you know, they are not rising up from inside her, from her head or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们不是从她体内、从她的脑海或其他地方涌现出来的。

sentences.en: On the other hand, and this I think is what distinguishes her from most visionaries, she's incredibly matter of fact about them.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我认为这正是她与大多数预言家的不同之处，她对这些声音的态度极其务实。

sentences.en: They are as real to her as her parents had been, or, you know, her friends back in Don Rémy.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，它们就像她的父母，或者她在栋雷米的朋辈一样真实。

sentences.en: So Cochin asks her, did St. Margaret speak English?
sentences.zh: 所以科雄问她：圣玛格丽特说英语吗？

sentences.en: And Joan thinks this is a ridiculous question.
sentences.zh: 贞德觉得这是一个荒谬的问题。

sentences.en: She laughs.
sentences.zh: 她笑了。

sentences.en: Why should she speak English?
sentences.zh: 她为什么要说英语？

sentences.en: She's not on the side of the English.
sentences.zh: 她又不是站在英国人那边的。

sentences.en: And then again, she's asked, well, what about St. Michael?
sentences.zh: 然后，她又被问到，那么圣米迦勒呢？

sentences.en: Did, you know, was he clothed or was he naked?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他是穿着衣服还是赤身裸体？

sentences.en: And Joan answers, well, ridiculous question.
sentences.zh: 贞德回答说，真是个荒谬的问题。

sentences.en: Of course God can clothe St. Michael.
sentences.zh: 上帝当然能给圣米迦勒穿上衣服。

sentences.en: And so I think it's unsurprising that her judges, who perhaps are too attuned to abstractions and to notions of the supernatural
sentences.zh: 所以我想，她的法官们对此感到意外也就不足为奇了，他们或许对抽象概念、超自然观念

sentences.en: and theology and so on, they really struggle to get a handle on the kind of the vividness of just how real these voices are to Joan.
sentences.zh: 以及神学等等太过敏锐，以至于他们很难真正理解这些声音对贞德而言究竟有多么鲜活和真实。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: They don't think that Joan is making this up.
sentences.zh: 他们并不认为贞德是在捏造这一切。

sentences.en: I think there is one inquisitor who does think this, who does think that she is deluded.
sentences.zh: 我想确实有一个审讯官是这么想的，他认为贞德是在妄想。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not unheard of for teenage girls to make up stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，十几岁的女孩编造事情并不是闻所未闻。

sentences.en: No, it is interesting.
sentences.zh: 不，这确实很有趣。

sentences.en: And I think when you read her testimony, you can see why they would believe that.
sentences.zh: 我想当你阅读她的证词时，你能明白他们为什么会相信这一点。

sentences.en: Because Joan is speaking with an utter conviction.
sentences.zh: 因为贞德说话时带着绝对的坚信。

sentences.en: And although we haven't really heard her in her own voice before this, except when she dictates her letters, I think the way in
sentences.zh: 尽管在此之前我们并没有真正听到她自己的声音，除了她口述信件的时候之外，但我认为她

sentences.en: which she convinces people that what she's saying is true, whether it be the king or her fellow
sentences.zh: 让人们相信她所言非虚的方式——无论是国王、她的船长同僚、普通士兵还是其他人——

sentences.en: captains or the common soldiers or whatever, there is an intensity and a conviction that is very convincing.
sentences.zh: 其中包含着一种极其具有说服力的强度和信念。

sentences.en: Now, of course, the issue then, once that is accepted, is if these voices are real, then what are they?
sentences.zh: 当然，一旦这一点被接受，接下来产生的问题就是：如果这些声音是真实的，那它们究竟是什么？

sentences.en: It is impossible for the inquisitors in Ruor to accept what Joan is insisting, that they are of heavenly origin.
sentences.zh: 鲁昂的审讯官们绝不可能接受贞德所坚称的观点，即它们起源于天堂。

sentences.en: Because of course, this is a political trial.
sentences.zh: 因为这毕竟是一场政治审判。

sentences.en: And if they accept that these voices are of heavenly origin, then that is immediately to destroy the legitimacy of the Lancastrian regime that they are serving.
sentences.zh: 如果他们承认这些声音来自天堂，那就等于直接摧毁了他们所效力的兰开斯特政权的合法性。

sentences.en: Equally, though, to condemn the voices as satanic raises its own issues.
sentences.zh: 然而同样地，将这些声音谴责为邪恶的也会带来自身的问题。

sentences.en: And the inquisitors are learned men, and a lot of them are honest men.
sentences.zh: 而且审讯官们都是饱学之士，其中许多人也是正直的人。

sentences.en: And they are troubled by the question of whether it is actually heretical to be deceived by Satan.
sentences.zh: 他们对这样一个问题感到困惑：被撒旦欺骗是否真的构成异端。

sentences.en: Because, you know, humans have fallen.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，人类已经堕落了。

sentences.en: We are all, in a sense, deceived by Satan.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我们都在被撒旦欺骗。

sentences.en: And Satan is very powerful.
sentences.zh: 而且撒旦非常强大。

sentences.en: Like, it's not your fault if Satan gets his teeth into you.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果撒旦缠上了你，那也不是你的错。

sentences.en: And so, another example of how this isn't just a kangaroo court, opinion among the assessors on this issue is split.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也证明了这并非一场走过场的袋鼠法庭，评审员们在这个问题上的意见也是分歧的。

sentences.en: And one of the theologians actually says, well, you know, this is above our pay grade.
sentences.zh: 其中一位神学家甚至说：好吧，你知道的，这超出了我们的职责范围。

sentences.en: I think we should really go and consult the Pope.
sentences.zh: 我想我们真该去请教一下教皇。

sentences.en: And of course, Cauchon and definitely
sentences.zh: 当然，科雄和

sentences.en: Warwick is having none of that.
sentences.zh: 沃里克绝对不会同意这一点。

sentences.en: You know, we can't afford to involve the Pope in this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们可担不起把教皇卷入其中的后果。

sentences.en: That would be terrible.
sentences.zh: 那太糟糕了。

sentences.en: So it's a bit of a nightmare for Cauchon.
sentences.zh: 所以这对科雄来说简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: And what he really needs is for Joan simply to confess her errors and recant, because that would cut the whole Gordian knot.
sentences.zh: 他真正需要的只是贞德承认错误并撤回前言，因为那将迎刃而解所有难题。

sentences.en: And so he and his fellow judges focus on two particular aspects of Joan's testimony.
sentences.zh: 因此，他和同僚法官们将注意力集中在贞德证词的两个特定方面。

sentences.en: And they've obviously kind of sniffed these two areas as being the ones where Joan is most vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 他们显然已经嗅出这两个领域正是贞德最脆弱的地方。

sentences.en: And the first of these, people may remember, at Tor, the Dauphin had asked Joan for a sign to reassure him that she really was who she said she was.
sentences.zh: 人们可能还记得，第一点是，在希农，法兰西摄政曾要求贞德给出一个迹象，以向他保证她确实就是她所说的那个人。

sentences.en: She really had been sent from by God.
sentences.zh: 她确实是受上帝派遣而来的。

sentences.en: And you didn't tell us what this sign was.
sentences.zh: 而你当时并没有告诉我们这个迹象是什么。

sentences.en: You kept this a secret, Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你把这个当成了秘密。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that is because Joan wanted to keep it a secret herself.
sentences.zh: 那是因为贞德自己想保守秘密。

sentences.en: She had been throughout the course of the trial, exceedingly reluctant to reveal it.
sentences.zh: 在整个审判过程中，她极其不愿意透露这一点。

sentences.en: And she kept insisting, you know, I have promised to keep this a secret.
sentences.zh: 她一直坚持说：你知道的，我答应过要保守这个秘密。

sentences.en: She doesn't actually say who to.
sentences.zh: 她其实并没有说向谁答应的。

sentences.en: I think the
sentences.zh: 我想

sentences.en: Inquisitors assumed that she had promised her voices, but it may be that she'd promised Charles the Seventh.
sentences.zh: 审讯官们以为她是对自己的声音做出了承诺，但也有可能是她向查理七世承诺过。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知。

sentences.en: Anyway, finally, she just gets worn down and she reveals the truth.
sentences.zh: 总之，最终她还是被磨得没有办法，吐露了真相。

sentences.en: And she says that an angel had appeared and had brought the Dauphin a crown of purest gold.
sentences.zh: 她说曾有一个天使显现，给法兰西摄政带来了一顶纯金的王冠。

sentences.en: The angel appeared to her and to the Dauphin.
sentences.zh: 那个天使向她和法兰西摄政显现了。

sentences.en: And to the Dauphin and to the court.
sentences.zh: 向法兰西摄政以及宫廷显现了。

sentences.en: Everyone in the court?
sentences.zh: 宫廷里的所有人都看见了？

sentences.en: Everyone in the court.
sentences.zh: 宫廷里的所有人都看见了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That this angel had been accompanied by a host of other angels and also by St. Catherine and by St. Margaret.
sentences.zh: 这个天使由一大群其他天使陪同着，还有圣凯瑟琳和圣玛格丽特一同随行。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: They're all crowded into the council chamber or whatever?
sentences.zh: 他们全都挤在议事厅里还是怎么着？

sentences.en: Well, Joan will later specify that they were very small.
sentences.zh: 嗯，贞德后来特意说明他们非常小。

sentences.en: I mean, I think she's implying that they're kind of shaded away into a different dimension.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想她的意思是他们隐入了另一个维度。

sentences.en: Throughout her account of this, she's obviously really struggling to make sense of something that she feels is real, but can't put into words.
sentences.zh: 在她对这段经历的描述中，她显然在极力试图去理解某种她觉得真实却又无法用言语表达的事物。

sentences.en: However, these are the words that she gives.
sentences.zh: 然而，这就是她给出的言辞。

sentences.en: She then says that the angel had given the crown to the Archbishop of Reims and that the Archbishop had then given it to the king.
sentences.zh: 她随后说，天使把王冠交给了兰斯大主教，然后大主教又把它交给了国王。

sentences.en: And I see your expression.
sentences.zh: 我看到你的表情了。

sentences.en: It's one of disbelief and, dare I say, contempt.
sentences.zh: 那是一种难以置信，甚至可以说是轻蔑的表情。

sentences.en: Well, you were not alone because the theologians listening to this, they just say, this is mad.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你并不孤单，因为听到这些的神学家们当时就说：这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This is ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这简直荒谬。

sentences.en: And there's one particular one from Paris who says, this is a presumptuous, misleading and pernicious falsehood, a fabricated matter that diminishes the dignity of angels.
sentences.zh: 其中有一位来自巴黎的特定学者说：这是一个狂妄自大、误导人且居心险恶的谎言，是一个贬低天使尊严的虚构故事。

sentences.en: I mean, that's my objection to it, actually, that it diminishes the dignity of angels.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这其实也是我对它的反对意见，它确实贬低了天使的尊严。

sentences.en: You would have served well on the bench of assessors at Joan's trial.
sentences.zh: 你在贞德审判的评审席上一定能表现得很出色。

sentences.en: I think I'd be a brilliant inquisitor, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我觉得我会是一个出色的审讯官。

sentences.en: So, the other issue, of course, is this perennial problem of her male clothing.
sentences.zh: 所以，另一个问题当然就是她穿男装这个老生常谈的难题了。

sentences.en: And the reason is because it opens Joan up to a very obvious accusation.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，这让贞德面临着一个非常明显的指控。

sentences.en: Joan says that, essentially, she is wearing her clothes, her male clothes, because the voices want her to wear them.
sentences.zh: 贞德说，本质上讲，她穿着这些衣服，也就是她的男装，是因为那些声音希望她穿。

sentences.en: However, this is in direct contradiction to the teachings of the church.
sentences.zh: 然而，这直接违背了教会的教义。

sentences.en: So, essentially, Joan is placing the testimony of her voices above that of the church.
sentences.zh: 因此，本质上，贞德是将她的声音的证词置于教会的权威之上。

sentences.en: And this is palpably heretical.
sentences.zh: 这显然是异端行为。

sentences.en: She hasn't got a leg to stand on here, basically.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她基本上已经无话可说、站不住脚了。

sentences.en: Not even a leg of male hose.
sentences.zh: 甚至连一条男士长袜的立足之地都没有。

sentences.en: It also, of course, in the opinion of her assessors, demonstrates that the voices are indeed satanic,
sentences.zh: 当然，在她的评审员们看来，这也证明了这些声音确实是邪恶撒旦的产物，

sentences.en: because the voices would not be instructing her to do something that is against biblical instructions.
sentences.zh: 因为声音绝不会指使她去做违背圣经教导的事情。

sentences.en: So, that also is something where they feel Joan is on a very sticky wicket.
sentences.zh: 所以，这也是他们觉得贞德处境极其艰难的一个方面。

sentences.en: So, on the 23rd of May, those two charges, the fact that she made up rubbish about, you know, the sign
sentences.zh: 因此，在5月23日，那两项指控——关于她为送给查理七世的那个迹象

sentences.en: that she gave Charles VII, and the fact that she insists on wearing male clothing, together with
sentences.zh: 胡编乱造，以及她坚持穿男装的事实——连同

sentences.en: 10 other charges, among which is the proposition that by jumping out of the 60-foot tower, she'd been
sentences.zh: 其他10项指控一起被提出，其中包括她通过跳下60英尺高的塔来试图自杀而非逃跑的推论，

sentences.en: trying to commit suicide rather than escape, and kind of various other items like that.
sentences.zh: 以及其他诸如此类的各种条目。

sentences.en: These are presented to Joan.
sentences.zh: 这些都被提交给了贞德。

sentences.en: She's told that, in the opinion of her judges, these charges satisfy them that she is indeed a heretic, and her judges require her to confess and to repent all these faults
sentences.zh: 她被告知，在法官们看来，这些指控足以证明她确实是一个异端，法官们要求她承认并忏悔所有这些过错，

sentences.en: if she is to be spared.
sentences.zh: 如果她想活命的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And she doesn't, does she?
sentences.zh: 而她并没有这么做，对吧？

sentences.en: For my words and deeds mentioned in this trial, I refer to them, and I wish to stand by them.
sentences.zh: 对于我在这次审判中提及的言行，我予以认可，并希望坚持到底。

sentences.en: So, she's going to stick to her guns.
sentences.zh: 所以，她打算坚持到底。

sentences.en: She's not going to change, you know, change her tune now.
sentences.zh: 她现在可不打算改变立场、改口了。

sentences.en: She's still standing strong.
sentences.zh: 她依然立场坚定。

sentences.en: So, the next day, a tumbril is brought to the foot of her tower.
sentences.zh: 于是第二天，一辆运囚车被开到了她塔楼的脚下。

sentences.en: Joan is led down.
sentences.zh: 贞德被带了下来。

sentences.en: She's put into the tumbril, and the tumbril then rattles through the streets of Rouen
sentences.zh: 她被推上囚车，然后囚车在鲁昂的街道上颠簸着前行，

sentences.en: to an abbey in the centre of the town, where there is a cemetery, and this is the largest open space in the city, and thousands have gathered there.
sentences.zh: 驶向市中心的一座修道院。那里有一处墓地，也是城里最大的开阔地，成千上万的人聚集在那里。

sentences.en: And they are gathered around a huge wooden stage, on which Cochon is sitting, his fellow judge, the Dominican, all the various other assessors from
sentences.zh: 他们聚集在一个巨大的木制舞台周围，科雄就坐在上面，同案的法官、多米尼加修道士，以及来自贞德

sentences.en: Joan's trial, and a host of ecclesiastical luminaries, of whom the leading figure is a genuine cardinal,
sentences.zh: 审判的各路评审员，还有一大批教会显贵，其中核心人物是一位真正的红衣主教，

sentences.en: the only English cardinal at the time, a guy called Henry Beaufort, who is also, he's the richest man in
sentences.zh: 也是当时唯一的英国红衣主教，一个名叫亨利·博福特的人，他同时也是

sentences.en: England, and he is the great uncle of Henry VI.
sentences.zh: 英格兰最富有的人，并且是亨利六世的叔外祖父。

sentences.en: So, a very serious player indeed.
sentences.zh: 所以，这绝对是一个举足轻重的大人物。

sentences.en: Warwick, of course, is also, you know, he's come to watch.
sentences.zh: 当然，沃里克也来了，你知道的，他是来看热闹的。

sentences.en: The Duke of Bedford is not there.
sentences.zh: 贝德福德公爵不在场。

sentences.en: He is absent in Paris, but of course, he is keeping a very close eye on proceedings as well.
sentences.zh: 他在巴黎不在本地，但当然，他也对审判进展密切注视着。

sentences.en: So, Joan is led to a scaffold, and she has been, she's stood there to hear her sentence.
sentences.zh: 于是贞德被带上了高台，她站在那里听取对她的判决。

sentences.en: Before the sentence is delivered, however, a theologian comes forward, joins her on the scaffold, and delivers a sermon,
sentences.zh: 然而，在宣判之前，一位神学家走上前去，在绞刑台上与她汇合，并发表了一篇布道，

sentences.en: and his text is, a branch cannot bear fruit of itself unless it remain in the vine.
sentences.zh: 他的经文主题是：枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子。

sentences.en: In other words, someone who detaches herself from the vine of the church is asking to be consigned to the fire.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，任何把自己从教会的葡萄树上剥离下来的人，就是在自取灭亡，等待被投入火中。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the, that's the subtext.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是它的潜台词。

sentences.en: Joan listens to the sermon.
sentences.zh: 贞德听着布道。

sentences.en: She still refuses to confess, and so Cochon rises to his feet, and he delivers his judgment, which is that the accused is a heretic,
sentences.zh: 她仍然拒绝忏悔，于是科雄站起身来，宣读了他的判决：被告是一名异端，

sentences.en: and therefore, like a withered vine, should be cast out of holy church, and handed to the secular arm, which, in effect, is Warwick and the English.
sentences.zh: 因此，就像一根枯萎的枝子一样，应当被逐出圣洁的教会，并交由世俗权力机关处置——实际上也就是沃里克和英国人。

sentences.en: And the executioner is standing by outside the cemetery, so beyond the consecrated ground of the abbey.
sentences.zh: 而刽子手正站在墓地外面待命，也就是在修道院圣地范围之外的地方。

sentences.en: A great bonfire has been prepared.
sentences.zh: 一座巨大的篝火堆已经准备就绪。

sentences.en: The stake has been erected.
sentences.zh: 火刑柱已经竖起。

sentences.en: Everything is ready to go.
sentences.zh: 一切准备就绪。

sentences.en: The sentence is that Joan is to be burned alive,
sentences.zh: 判决结果是，贞德将被活活烧死，

sentences.en: consumed by the purifying flames of fire.
sentences.zh: 在纯净的烈焰中被吞噬。

sentences.en: So, the end is approaching, Tom, but is there a twist?
sentences.zh: 所以，结局即将来临，汤姆，但会有什么转折吗？

sentences.en: There is Dominic.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克来了。

sentences.en: Because as Cochon is saying this, suddenly, unexpectedly, Joan rises to her feet.
sentences.zh: 因为就在科雄说这话的时候，突然、出乎意料地，贞德站了起来。

sentences.en: And Cochon is so surprised by this that he hesitates.
sentences.zh: 科雄对此大吃一惊，以至于犹豫了。

sentences.en: And as he hesitates, Joan raises her voice again, and she declares, to the astonishment of everyone gathered there, that she is going to submit to the
sentences.zh: 就在他犹豫之际，贞德再次提高音量，在现场所有人的震惊中，她宣布自己

sentences.en: church and her judges, after all.
sentences.zh: 最终还是要向教会和法官们屈服。

sentences.en: She is going to abjure her visions and revelations, and she repeats this over and over again.
sentences.zh: 她将放弃自己的神视和天启，她一遍又一遍地重复着这一点。

sentences.en: Joan the Maid, at the very last moment, has been brought to submit.
sentences.zh: 贞德，这位少女，在最后一刻选择了屈服。

sentences.en: Crikey, what a twiSt. Come back after the break to find out what happens next.
sentences.zh: 天哪，真是个大反转。休息过后回来揭晓接下来会发生什么。

sentences.zh: 你什么都没做！

sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《历史其余部分》。
