sentences.en: So after all that, after all her defiance at the trial, Joan of Arc, to the astonishment of her judges, of the Bishop of Beauvais, Monsieur Couchon,
sentences.zh: 所以在经历了这一切之后，在她审判时表现出的所有抗拒之后，圣女贞德，在她的法官们、博韦主教蒙谢·科雄、

sentences.en: and everybody else who has gathered in the centre of Rouen to see her condemnation to the flames, she has just recanted, abjured her sins.
sentences.zh: 以及所有聚集在鲁昂市中心来看她被判处火刑的人的震惊中，她刚刚撤回了前言，忏悔了自己的罪过。

sentences.en: And Couchon, who expected her to go down fighting, is so stunned by this, isn't he, that he doesn't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 而原本期待她抗争到底的科雄，对此震惊得说不出话来了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so he turns to Cardinal Beaufort and says, well, what on earth do I do now?
sentences.zh: 于是他转向博福特红衣主教，说道，嗯，我现在到底该怎么办？

sentences.en: And Beaufort replies that Joan has spoken out as a penitent.
sentences.zh: 博福特回答说，贞德已经作为一名忏悔者表态了。

sentences.en: And so therefore there can be no question of handing her over to the secular arm.
sentences.zh: 因此，根本不存在将她移交给世俗权力机关的问题。

sentences.en: In other words, Warwick and the English guards.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是沃里克和英国卫兵。

sentences.en: And instead, she should be classed back into the bosom of Mother Church.
sentences.zh: 相反，她应该重新回到母亲教会的怀抱中。

sentences.en: And this, I think, is a big reassurance to Couchon, because, of course, Beaufort, you know, he's not just a cardinal,
sentences.zh: 我想，这对科雄来说是一个巨大的安慰，因为当然了，博福特不仅仅是一位红衣主教，

sentences.en: so he knows what he's talking about on the theological dimension, but he is also the great uncle of Henry VI.
sentences.zh: 所以他在神学层面上的发言很有分量，但他同时也是亨利六世的叔外公。

sentences.en: So he can be presumed to be speaking for the English establishment at the same time.
sentences.zh: 因此可以推断，他同时也代表了英国当权派的立场。

sentences.en: And so Couchon, you know, he's got the backing of the cardinal.
sentences.zh: 所以科雄得到了红衣主教的支持。

sentences.en: So he stands up and he orders that Joan's abjuration be drawn up in the form of a document.
sentences.zh: 于是他站起来，下令将贞德的忏悔书起草成一份文件。

sentences.en: And this document obliges Joan specifically to acknowledge that she had been the dupe of evil spirits.
sentences.zh: 这份文件专门迫使贞德承认她曾受到恶魔的愚弄。

sentences.en: And the emphasis on that word dupe.
sentences.zh: 重点就在“愚弄”这个词上。

sentences.en: So she is not admitting to witchcraft, but she is publicly stating that she had been tricked by satanic forces when she led Charles VII to his coronation in ReiMs.
sentences.zh: 所以她并没有承认巫术，但她公开声明，当她带领查理七世在兰斯加冕时，她是受到了撒旦力量的欺骗。

sentences.en: And this, in the opinion of Couchon, is sufficient.
sentences.zh: 在科雄看来，这就足够了。

sentences.en: Job done.
sentences.zh: 大功告成。

sentences.en: You know, he's got his result.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他得到了他想要的结果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So she wasn't colluding with evil.
sentences.zh: 所以她没有勾结邪恶。

sentences.en: She was deluded by evil.
sentences.zh: 她是被邪恶迷惑了。

sentences.en: That's an important, important difference, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的区别，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so this abjuration is then brought to Joan and she marks it with a cross.
sentences.zh: 于是这份悔罪书被送到贞德面前，她在上面画了一个十字。

sentences.en: And Couchon now delivers his sentence on the penitent.
sentences.zh: 科雄现在对这位忏悔者宣判。

sentences.en: First of all, he releases her from the bonds of her excommunication.
sentences.zh: 首先，他解除她的绝罚令。

sentences.en: But then in the very next sentence, he delivers a crushing blow, which obviously stuns Joan, who I think was expecting that with her abjuration, she would be set free.
sentences.zh: 但紧接着在下一句话中，他给出了沉重的一击，这显然震惊了贞德，我想她原本以为随着她的忏悔，她会重获自由。

sentences.en: Couchon declares, Because you have rashly sinned against God, we condemn you to a salutary penance of perpetual
sentences.zh: 科雄宣告：“鉴于你鲁莽地得罪了上帝，我们判处你进行有益的忏悔，即永远

sentences.en: imprisonment with the bread of sorrow and the water of affliction that you may weep there for your faults.
sentences.zh: 监禁，以悲伤之面包和苦难之水度日，以便你在那里为自己的过错痛哭流涕。”

sentences.en: And Joan is then bundled away and she is led back to her cell where a few hours later she is visited by a delegation of clerics.
sentences.zh: 随后贞德被粗暴地带走，关回了牢房，几个小时后，一队神职人员代表团探望了她。

sentences.en: And they bring her a dress, a woman's dress, which she obediently puts on.
sentences.zh: 他们给她带来了一件衣服，一件女装，她顺从地穿上了。

sentences.en: And she is then shaved bald so that all traces of her, you know, her masculine haircut is gone.
sentences.zh: 然后她被剃光了头，这样她身上所有那些，你知道的，男式发型的痕迹就都消失了。

sentences.en: So a big blow to Joan this because she, I think, probably very naively thought that they would just say, oh, well, you know, off you go.
sentences.zh: 这对贞德来说是一个沉重的打击，因为我想她可能非常天真地以为他们会说，噢，好吧，你知道的，你走吧。

sentences.en: Well done.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.en: But she's going to be locked up forever.
sentences.zh: 但她却要被永远锁起来了。

sentences.en: Now, what do the English high command think?
sentences.zh: 现在，英国高级指挥官们是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Because they wanted to make a real example of her because they genuinely believed that she
sentences.zh: 因为他们想拿她杀鸡儆猴，因为他们真的相信她

sentences.en: was serving the interests of Satan and supporting the French and hearing her voices and stuff.
sentences.zh: 在为撒旦的利益服务，支持法国人，还听到什么神谕之类的话。

sentences.en: And now they've been slightly frustrated of their goal, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 现在他们的目标有点受挫了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, Bedford isn't actually there.
sentences.zh: 对，不过贝德福德其实并不在场。

sentences.en: But I think there's no question that all along his goal has been to see Joan condemned as a sorceress because her powers of witchcraft are essentially what excuse him his failures.
sentences.zh: 但我认为毫无疑问，他一直以来的目标都是看到贞德被判为女巫，因为她的巫术能力基本上是他为自己失败开脱的借口。

sentences.en: If he can blame, you know, the disasters that have overwhelmed the Lancastrian regime in
sentences.zh: 如果他能把那些压垮兰开斯特政权在法国的灾难归咎于巫术，

sentences.en: France on sorcery, then in a sense, he is absolved of personal failure.
sentences.zh: 那么某种程度上，他就免去了个人的失败责任。

sentences.en: And this, of course, is a kind of tribute to Joan.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是对贞德的一种“褒奖”。

sentences.en: It's an acknowledgement that I suppose that rather than just being a dupe, you know, she'd been something much more sinister, much more significant, you know, that she personally
sentences.zh: 这是一种承认，我想，比起仅仅是一个被愚弄的人，她其实是个更阴险、更重要的人物，你知道的，她个人

sentences.en: had been the agent of English misfortunes, which in turn is to cast her as someone kind of special.
sentences.zh: 一直是英国人厄运的始作俑者，反过来，这也把她塑造成了一个某种程度上很特别的人。

sentences.en: And I think there's an irony here because for Joan, the sense of herself as someone special,
sentences.zh: 我认为这里面有一种讽刺，因为对贞德来说，她觉得自己是个特殊的人这种感觉，

sentences.en: I think that also was, you know, that was very important to her.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是，你知道的，对她非常重要。

sentences.en: And I think that in the days that follow her confession, she starts to reflect on this and
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在她认罪后的几天里，她开始反思这一点，

sentences.en: she thinks, I've given up this sense of myself as God's medium, as God's messenger in exchange for life imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 她心想，我为了换取终身监禁，竟然放弃了自己作为上帝媒介、上帝信使的身份感。

sentences.en: Is that a reasonable exchange?
sentences.zh: 这笔交易划算吗？

sentences.en: And so she falls to, you know, well, to pondering her future.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始，你知道的，思考自己的未来。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's given up her identity, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，她放弃了自己的身份，对吧？

sentences.en: As she sees it.
sentences.zh: 在她看来是这样的。

sentences.en: She's given up what made her special.
sentences.zh: 她放弃了让她与众不同的东西。

sentences.en: And now she's bitterly regretting it because she's just sitting there in prison.
sentences.zh: 现在她正在深切地后悔，因为她只能孤零零地坐在监狱里。

sentences.en: And that will be her reality for the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 这将是她余生的现实。

sentences.en: And she's betrayed her king.
sentences.zh: 而且她背叛了她的国王。

sentences.en: And I think most crucially of all, she has betrayed her voices.
sentences.zh: 我想最关键的是，她背叛了她的神谕。

sentences.en: And so four days after her recantation, ominous news is brought to Cochon and to Warwick that
sentences.zh: 因此，在她撤回悔罪的四天后，科雄和沃里克得到了一条不祥的消息，

sentences.en: Joan has put her male clothes back on.
sentences.zh: 那就是贞德重新穿上了男装。

sentences.en: When her assessors come to see her, she gives various reasons for doing this.
sentences.zh: 当法官们来看她时，她给出了这样做的各种理由。

sentences.en: First of all, she claims that she was tricked into swearing never again to wear men's clothes, that she hadn't realized that was what she was doing.
sentences.zh: 首先，她声称自己是被骗才发誓再也不穿男装的，她当时并没有意识到那就是自己在做的事。

sentences.en: She then, I think, also strongly implies that her guards were sexually abusing her.
sentences.zh: 我想，随后她还强烈暗示她的看守在性侵她。

sentences.en: So to quote the record of the clerk who was taking the minutes, that being among men, she thought that wearing men's clothes was more lawful and appropriate than wearing women's.
sentences.zh: 引用当时做记录的书记官的话来说，那就是身处男人之中，她认为穿男装比穿女装更合乎情理、更为妥当。

sentences.en: And she also declared that she would rather die than spend her entire life, you know, fettered, living on bread and water.
sentences.zh: 她还宣称，她宁愿死，也不愿终其一生被戴上枷锁、靠面包和水度日。

sentences.en: And so her judges, I think, are clearly stunned by this.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，她的法官们对此显然震惊不已。

sentences.en: And they say to her, well, you know, if this was the case, why ever did you confess?
sentences.zh: 他们对她说，好吧，既然如此，你当初到底为什么要认罪？

sentences.en: Why ever did you abjure?
sentences.zh: 你当初到底为什么要发誓悔改？

sentences.en: And then comes, I think, the most touching moment in the whole story of Joan.
sentences.zh: 然后迎来了整个贞德故事中最触动人心的时刻。

sentences.en: She answers very simply, and it brings home to you, this is a teenage girl.
sentences.zh: 她非常简单地回答了，这让你真切地意识到，这不过是一个十几岁的女孩。

sentences.en: She says, I did it for fear of the fire.
sentences.zh: 她说，我这么做是出于对烈火的恐惧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's, I kind of find it heart-rending.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得这分外揪心。

sentences.en: And perhaps even at this late moment, she might still have saved herself.
sentences.zh: 也许甚至在这个为时已晚的时刻，她本仍可以自救。

sentences.en: But then comes the straw that breaks the inquisitorial back.
sentences.zh: 但接着，成了压垮审讯者骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: Again, to quote the clerk, he's been taking the minutes.
sentences.zh: 同样，引用一直在做记录的书记官的话。

sentences.en: She was asked whether she had heard the voices of St. Catherine and St. Margaret since the last Thursday, which is when she had repented.
sentences.zh: 有人问她，自从上周四（也就是她忏悔的那天）以来，她是否听到了圣凯瑟琳和圣玛格丽特的声音。

sentences.en: She said yes.
sentences.zh: 她说听到了。

sentences.en: Oh no, she's back on the voices again.
sentences.zh: 哦不，她又开始听见神谕了。

sentences.en: And the clerk then later scribbled in the margin of the minutes this single comment,
sentences.zh: 书记官随后在会议记录的空白处潦草地写下了这句唯一的评论，

sentences.en: responsio mortifera, a fatal reply, the reply that is going to kill her.
sentences.zh: 致命的回答，一个将置她于死地的回答。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because the very next day, the 29th of May,
sentences.zh: 因为就在第二天，也就是5月29日，

sentences.en: Cochon gathers his experts in theology and canon and civil law.
sentences.zh: 科雄召集了他的神学、教会法和民法专家。

sentences.en: They meet in the archbishop's residence in Rouen, and their verdict is unanimous, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 他们在鲁昂的大主教官邸会面，他们的裁决是全票通过的，不是吗？

sentences.en: But Joan is now very, she has outed herself very clearly in defiance of the court and of their opinion as a heretic.
sentences.zh: 但贞德现在非常明确地公开抗拒法庭和他们的意见，表现得像个异端。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so that being so, the church washes her hands of her and they decree that she is unregenerate and therefore excommunicate and therefore to be handed over to the secular power.
sentences.zh: 既然如此，教会便对她撒手不管，并宣判她无可救药，因此已被逐出教会，必须移交给世俗权力机关。

sentences.en: And the next day, early in the morning, very early in the morning, one last deputation of clerics come to visit her.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，天色极早的时候，最后一拨神职人员代表团来探望她。

sentences.en: And you can imagine how thrilling that must be for Joan on her last day.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，在贞德生命的最后一天，这让她感到多么烦人。

sentences.en: Yeah, another load of clerics.
sentences.zh: 对，又来了一群神职人员。

sentences.en: And Joan talks to them in very muted, very despondent tones as well she might have done.
sentences.zh: 贞德用一种非常低沉、非常沮丧的语气跟他们说话，她本该如此。

sentences.en: And you can see what she's been thinking about from the topics that she brings up.
sentences.zh: 从她提起的话题中，你可以看出她一直在思考什么。

sentences.en: So her thoughts are still very much on Charles VII and that sign that she had given him.
sentences.zh: 所以她的心思仍然很大程度上停留在查理七世身上，以及她给过他的那个信物上。

sentences.en: And you can tell that she has been turning it over in her mind that she's really been struggling to make sense of what precisely had happened.
sentences.zh: 你能看出她一直在脑海里反复琢磨，她一直在努力去弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And she says that, yes, there had been an angel who had given the Dauphin a crown, but that angel, she now says, had been herself.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的，确实曾有一个天使给过王太子一顶王冠，但她现在说，那个天使其实就是她自己。

sentences.en: That's a mad thing to say.
sentences.zh: 这话听起来真疯狂。

sentences.en: Do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: She's gone from saying the room was packed with angels who were two feet tall to saying, actually, I was the angel.
sentences.zh: 她从一开始说房间里挤满了两英尺高的天使，变成了现在说，其实我就是那个天使。

sentences.en: I think to say I was the angel is high risk.
sentences.zh: 我觉得说“我就是天使”风险极高。

sentences.en: I think that it was a very intense moment for her.
sentences.zh: 我认为对她来说这是一个非常情绪激动的时刻。

sentences.en: I mean, who knows what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁知道当时到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: But definitely she felt that something had happened and that she is trying to make sense of it still in her very last hours.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，她觉得自己经历了一些事，并且在最后的几个小时里，她仍然在试图去理解它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then, of course, she speaks of her voices and she declares, whether they are good or evil spirits, they appear to me.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，她谈到了她的神谕，并宣称，无论它们是善灵还是恶灵，它们都向我显现了。

sentences.en: So that suggests a degree of doubt that she's wobbling again.
sentences.zh: 所以这表明她再次动摇，心存疑虑。

sentences.en: I don't think she's wobbling, but that she loves them and she's going to stay loyal to them, even if, you know, at the cost of being burnt to death.
sentences.zh: 我不认为她动摇了，而是她深爱着他们，并且打算对他们保持忠诚，哪怕代价是被活活烧死。

sentences.en: So then a friar enters the cell and he hears Joan's confession.
sentences.zh: 接着一名修士进入牢房，听取了贞德的忏悔。

sentences.en: And then throughout the term of her imprisonment, Joan has been denied communion, been denied the EuchariSt.
sentences.zh: 在整个关押期间，贞德一直被剥夺领圣餐的权利，被剥夺了圣体。

sentences.en: And she has a great devotion to the EuchariSt.
sentences.zh: 她对圣体怀有极大的虔诚。

sentences.en: And so this has been a source of great distress to her.
sentences.zh: 因此这给她带来了极大的痛苦。

sentences.en: And now I think a gesture of mercy on Cochon's part, he allows her to have communion.
sentences.zh: 而现在我认为科雄表现出了一丝仁慈，他允许她领圣餐。

sentences.en: So that's nice of him.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说倒挺好。

sentences.en: Well, that's kind.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这挺善良的。

sentences.en: It's now nine o'clock and it is the morning of the 30th of May, 1431.
sentences.zh: 现在是早上九点，1431年5月30日的早晨。

sentences.en: And Joan is brought from her cell.
sentences.zh: 贞德被带出了牢房。

sentences.en: She's weeping.
sentences.zh: 她在哭泣。

sentences.en: She is surrounded by a large squad of English soldiers and they escort her from the castle to the market square in Rouen, where inevitably a huge crowd.
sentences.zh: 她被一大队英国士兵包围着，他们护送她从城堡前往鲁昂的市场广场，那里不出意料地聚集了巨大的人群。

sentences.en: They've picked up on the news.
sentences.zh: 他们听说了这个消息。

sentences.en: They've gathered.
sentences.zh: 他们聚集了起来。

sentences.en: Joan is in male clothes.
sentences.zh: 贞德穿着男装。

sentences.en: So she's not forced into a dress.
sentences.zh: 所以她没有被强迫穿裙子。

sentences.en: And on her head, she wears a kind of a cap, like kind of old fashioned dunces cap.
sentences.zh: 在她的头上，她戴着一种帽子，有点像老式的笨蛋帽。

sentences.en: It's inscribed with the words heretic, relapse, apostate, idolater.
sentences.zh: 上面写着异端、再犯、叛教者、偶像崇拜者等字样。

sentences.en: So that's all bad news.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都不是好消息。

sentences.en: And basically the format on this morning is the same as it had been six days previously.
sentences.zh: 基本上，今天早上的流程和六天前一模一样。

sentences.en: So a sermon is given and then Cochon reads out the sentence.
sentences.zh: 因此先进行布道，然后科雄宣读判决书。

sentences.en: But this time, Joan keeps silent.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，贞德保持沉默。

sentences.en: The sentence is delivered and accepted.
sentences.zh: 判决宣读并被接受。

sentences.en: And Joan is then handed over to the English guards who remove her up to the top of an immense bonfire.
sentences.zh: 随后贞德被交给了英国守卫，他们将她带到一座巨大的火刑堆的顶部。

sentences.en: And Joan is weeping and she requests crucifix.
sentences.zh: 贞德在哭泣，她请求一个十字架。

sentences.en: And an English guard with a kind of display of mercy, of kindness, of sympathy, gives her a makeshift crucifix.
sentences.zh: 一名英国守卫出于某种展示仁慈、善良和同情的姿态，给了她一个临时拼凑的十字架。

sentences.en: And Joan hugs it to her chest as she is then chained and bound to the stake.
sentences.zh: 当她被用铁链和绳索绑在木桩上时，贞德把它紧紧抱在胸前。

sentences.en: And the fire is lit and the smoke begins to rise.
sentences.zh: 接着火被点燃，浓烟开始升起。

sentences.en: And Joan, her lips had been moving in silent prayer throughout.
sentences.zh: 而贞德，她的双唇一直在无声地祈祷着。

sentences.en: And then people in the crowd hear her cry out through the smoke, Jesus, Jesus, Jesus.
sentences.zh: 然后人群中的人们透过浓烟听到她大声喊着：耶稣，耶稣，耶稣。

sentences.en: And in due course, decades later, lots of stories would be told of her death.
sentences.zh: 在适的时候，几十年后，关于她之死流传着许多故事。

sentences.en: So there's a story that a priest had rushed to a nearby church and had brought out a crucifix from there, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此有个故事说，一名牧师冲进附近的一家教堂，从里面拿出一个十字架，你知道的，

sentences.en: on a great kind of pole and held it up before her for as long as she could see it until the smoke blotted it out.
sentences.zh: 绑在一根长长的杆子上，在她还能看见的时候高高举在她面前，直到浓烟遮蔽了视线。

sentences.en: That the executioner, that one of the English soldiers, even Cardinal Beaufort himself, had wept to watch her fate and that her heart, no matter how repeatedly the fire was stoked,
sentences.zh: 还有传言说行刑手、其中一名英国士兵、甚至博福特枢机主教本人，看到她的命运时都落泪了，而且她的心无论火被加添多少次，

sentences.en: refused to burn.
sentences.zh: 都拒绝燃烧。

sentences.en: And again, people can make of those stories what they will.
sentences.zh: 同样，人们可以对这些故事作何感想见仁见智。

sentences.en: But of one thing, there is no doubt, once the embers had cooled, her ashes were swept up and they were dumped unceremoniously into the Seine.
sentences.zh: 但有一点毫无疑问，一旦余烬冷却，她的骨灰就被扫起，毫无仪式感地倾倒进塞纳河中。

sentences.en: So six and a half months after that in Paris, in Notre Dame, no less, Henry VI was crowned as Henry II of France.
sentences.zh: 因此，在那之后的六个半月里，在巴黎的巴黎圣母院里，亨利六世加冕为法兰西国王亨利二世。

sentences.en: Now, meanwhile, in the court of Charles VII, the rival court, has Joan been turned into a martyr?
sentences.zh: 然而与此同时，在查理七世的宫廷，即对立的宫廷里，贞德被变成殉道者了吗？

sentences.en: Have there been howls of protest?
sentences.zh: 有没有发出抗议的怒吼？

sentences.en: Has her death become a symbol of suffering, of the sanctity of France violated by the English?
sentences.zh: 她的死是否成为了苦难的象征，成为了法国神圣性被英国人践踏的象征？

sentences.en: No, they don't make anything of Joan at all.
sentences.zh: 不，他们根本没有把贞德当回事。

sentences.en: Isn't that extraordinary that Charles VII, who owes her so much, basically acts as though she'd never existed?
sentences.zh: 这难道不令人匪夷所思吗？查理七世欠她那么多，基本上却表现得好像她从未存在过一样？

sentences.en: Well, is it extraordinary?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的很匪夷所思吗？

sentences.en: I'm not sure it is, because Joan has become a huge embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是不是，因为贞德已经成了一个巨大的尴尬。

sentences.en: And, you know, she is now a condemned heretic.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，她现在是一个被定罪的异端。

sentences.en: So Charles VII, Charles VII wants to keep very, very quiet about it.
sentences.zh: 所以查理七世，查理七世想要对此保持极其低调。

sentences.en: But the thing is, people do not forget about her.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，人们并没有忘记她。

sentences.en: She remains very much an emblem of French resistance, despite her fate.
sentences.zh: 尽管命运多舛，她依然是法国抵抗运动的象征。

sentences.en: And her death does not lead to a revival of Lancastrian fortunes.
sentences.zh: 她的死并没有带来兰开斯特王朝财富的复苏。

sentences.en: And the coronation of Henry in Notre Dame does not blot out the memory of how Charles VII, with Joan at his side, had been crowned in ReiMs.
sentences.zh: 亨利在巴黎圣母院的加冕并没有抹去查理七世在贞德陪伴下于兰斯加冕的记忆。

sentences.en: And the continuing silence of Charles VII, the ungrateful silence of Charles VII, one might say,
sentences.zh: 而查理七世持续的沉默，查理七世忘恩负义的沉默，可以这么说，

sentences.en: his refusal so much as to mention the name of this peasant girl who had done so much to save him from ruin.
sentences.zh: 他甚至拒绝提及这位为拯救他免于破产做出巨大贡献的农家女孩的名字。

sentences.en: This doesn't mean that Charles has forgotten, Joan.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着查理已经忘记了贞德。

sentences.en: And actually, in due course, 19 years after she had been burnt to death in Rouen, in February 1450, finally Charles does speak her name.
sentences.zh: 事实上，适时地，在她于鲁昂被活活烧死19年后的1450年2月，查理终于说出了她的名字。

sentences.en: And he says, a long time ago, Jeanne Lapucel was taken and captured by our ancient enemies and adversaries, the English, and brought to the city of Rouen.
sentences.zh: 他说，很久以前，圣女贞德被我们的古代敌人和对手英国人俘虏并抓获，带到了鲁昂城。

sentences.en: And the reason that Charles feels able to speak her name at last is because since Joan's death and 1450, so much has changed.
sentences.zh: 查理之所以觉得自己终于可以念出她的名字，是因为自贞德死后到1450年，发生了太多的变化。

sentences.en: So, to go through some of the bullet points, in 1435, the Duke of Burgundy, Philip the Good,
sentences.zh: 因此，回顾一些要点，1435年，勃艮第公爵菲利普良公，

sentences.en: who for so long had been resolute in his refusal to reach terms with the guy who he blamed for murdering his father, namely Charles VII,
sentences.zh: 他长期以来坚决拒绝与他认为是谋杀其父亲（即查理七世）凶手的人达成妥协，

sentences.en: he does come to terms with Charles VII, and a pact is signed between France and Burgundy, and this effectively leaves the English alone.
sentences.zh: 他确实与查理七世妥协了，法国和勃艮第签署了一项条约，这实际上让英国人孤立无援。

sentences.en: Following year, Charles VII enters Paris.
sentences.zh: 第二年，查理七世进入巴黎。

sentences.en: He has reclaimed the capital of France.
sentences.zh: 他收复了法国的首都。

sentences.en: 1440, a real straw in the wind.
sentences.zh: 1440年，出现了一个真正的风向标。

sentences.en: The English are so desperate to try and patch up terms that they allow the Duke of Orléans,
sentences.zh: 英国人迫切想要拼凑出一份协议，以至于他们允许奥尔良公爵——

sentences.en: who'd been kept as a prisoner in England since the Battle of Agincourt, they allow him to come home, back to France.
sentences.zh: 自从阿金库尔战役以来一直被当作人囚禁在英国——回到法国。

sentences.en: And his captivity had been the longest of any prisoner in the entire history of the Hundred Years' War.
sentences.zh: 而他的囚禁是百年战争整个历史上所有囚犯中最长的一次。

sentences.en: And then in 1449, Charles VII embarks on the conquest of Normandy, and in November 1449, so that is four months before he finally mentions the name of Joan of Arc,
sentences.zh: 然后在1449年，查理七世开始征服诺曼底，并在1449年11月——也就是他最终提及圣女贞德名字的四个月前——

sentences.en: he had entered Rouen, the capital of English Normandy, and he does so beneath the fluttering of the standard of Saint Michael, the archangel.
sentences.zh: 他进入了英国诺曼底的首府鲁昂，并且是在大天使圣米迦勒军旗的飘扬下做到的。

sentences.en: And by his side, his greatest captain is with him.
sentences.zh: 在他的身旁，伴随着他最伟大的将领。

sentences.en: And this is the man who is no longer known as the Bastard of Orléans, but since 1439, as the Count of Dunois,
sentences.zh: 这就是那个不再被称为奥尔良私生子，而自1439年起被称为迪努瓦伯爵的人，

sentences.en: the guy who had been at Joan's side at her greatest triumph, at the relief of the siege of Orléans.
sentences.zh: 那个在贞德最伟大的胜利——解奥尔良之围时——一直陪伴在她身旁的人。

sentences.en: So it's now when they reclaim Rouen, 19 years later, that they finally address the issue of Joan and her treatment by the English.
sentences.zh: 所以正是在19年后他们收复鲁昂时，他们最终处理了贞德以及英国人对她的对待这一问题。

sentences.en: And this is the point at which Charles VII, basically, I guess he kind of institutionalizes the idea that Joan was a martyr destroyed by a kangaroo court.
sentences.zh: 这就是查理七世基本上——我猜他将贞德是一个被袋鼠法庭摧毁的殉道者的观点制度化了的时刻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So again, you know, in this proclamation that he issues in February 1450, the English had tried Joan by certain persons who had been chosen and given this task by them.
sentences.zh: 因此同样，你知道的，在他于1450年2月发布的这份公告中，英国人通过某些被他们挑选并委以重任的人对贞德进行了审判。

sentences.en: And during this trial, they made and committed several errors and abuses such that by means of this trial and the great hatred that our enemy had against her,
sentences.zh: 在这场审判中，他们制造并犯下了多项错误和滥权行为，以至于通过这场审判以及我们的敌人对她的极度仇恨，

sentences.en: they had her put to death very cruelly, iniquitously and against reason.
sentences.zh: 他们极其残忍、不义且违背理性地将她处死。

sentences.en: And you can see why Charles is now saying this, because if he can have that original verdict scrubbed, then that is a real help in legitimizing his own coronation.
sentences.zh: 你能看出查理现在为什么要这么说，因为如果他能让最初的判决被抹去，那对合法化他自己的加冕礼将是一个巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: And Charles VII does what leaders do today when they want something done.
sentences.zh: 查理七世做的是当今领导人想把事情办成时会做的事。

sentences.en: They institute a public inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他们发起了一项公众调查。

sentences.en: And for the next six years, a succession of these inquiries, these inquests, these reports are delivered and they culminate in an official retrial.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六年里，一连串的调查、研讯和报告被提交，并最终汇聚成一次官方的重审。

sentences.en: And they sift through all the details of Joan's life and all the details of her death.
sentences.zh: 他们仔细审查了贞德一生的所有细节以及她死亡的所有细节。

sentences.en: And it has to be said that while this is going on, on the public, you know, the public stage of France, great events continue to happen.
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，当这一切正在进行时，在法国的公众舞台上，伟大的事件仍在继续发生。

sentences.en: And these events serve as a reminder to everyone in France that Joan, you know, she'd said that she would relieve the siege of all year she did.
sentences.zh: 这些事件提醒着法国的每一个人，贞德曾说过她会解除所有的围城，而她确实做到了。

sentences.en: She said that she would crown Charles VII and she did.
sentences.zh: 她说过她会为查理七世加冕，而她也做到了。

sentences.en: And she had said that the English would be, to quote her, kicked out of France.
sentences.zh: 她曾说过英国人将被——引用她的话——从法国被踢出去。

sentences.en: You know, by 1456, when the retrial is staged, that has come true.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，到了1456年重审举行时，这已经成为了现实。

sentences.en: So in 1450, the French complete their conquest of Normandy.
sentences.zh: 因此在1450年，法国人完成了对诺曼底的征服。

sentences.en: In 1451, Gascony in the southwest of France, so Bordeaux and all of that, you know, being a possession of the English crown for 300 years by this point, the French take that back.
sentences.zh: 在1451年，法国西南部加斯科涅，也就是波尔多以及那一带，当时作为英国王室的领地已有300年之久，法国人将其收复。

sentences.en: 1453, the old war dog, Sir John Talbot, you know, the guy who'd been fighting at Orléans, who'd been captured at Pate,
sentences.zh: 1453年，老战将约翰·塔尔博特爵士——你知道的，那个曾在奥尔良作战、在帕提被俘，

sentences.en: who had remained the most menacing of all the English captains resisting the French.
sentences.zh: 并且一直是所有抵抗法国的英国将领中最具威胁性的人。

sentences.en: He gets killed.
sentences.zh: 他阵亡了。

sentences.en: His army gets wiped out in Gascony by French artillery.
sentences.zh: 他的军队在加斯科涅被法国火炮全歼。

sentences.en: It's a very symbolic moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极具象征意义的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, the longbowmen are superseded.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，长弓手被取代了。

sentences.en: The age of English military supremacy has gone.
sentences.zh: 英国军事霸权的时代已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: And in effect, the death of Talbot at the Battle of Castagnon in 1453 marks the end of the Hundred Years' War.
sentences.zh: 实际上，塔尔博特在1453年卡斯蒂永战役中的阵亡标志着百年战争的结束。

sentences.en: And of all the many conquests of Edward III, of Henry V, there is only one tiny fragment of France that remains to England.
sentences.zh: 在爱德华三世和亨利五世的众多征服中，只剩下一小块法国领土仍属于英国。

sentences.en: And that, of course, is Calais.
sentences.zh: 当然，那就是加来。

sentences.en: And even that will be lost a century later in the reign of Mary Tudor.
sentences.zh: 甚至连这块领地也将在一个世纪后玛丽·都铎统治期间失守。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But the real moment that sets the seal on France's victory comes in July 1456.
sentences.zh: 但真正为法国胜利盖棺定论的时刻发生在1456年7月。

sentences.en: The 7th of July, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 是7月7日，对吧？

sentences.en: It comes in the palace of the Archbishop of Rouen.
sentences.zh: 它发生在鲁昂大主教的宫殿里。

sentences.en: And this is the day that the judges who have been appointed to review Joan of Arc, Jean Lapucelle's trial, that they meet to announce the results of their inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这一天，被指派重新审视圣女贞德（让娜·拉普塞勒）审判的法官们开会宣布了他们的调查结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, and they have, you know, they've consulted a great number of people.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们，你知道的，他们咨询了大量的人。

sentences.en: So people who've known Joan, everyone from Joan's mother to Dunois, the bastard of Orléans, and the Duke of Alençon, you know, people remember, you know, her biggest ducal fan.
sentences.zh: 比如认识贞德的人，从贞德的母亲到奥尔良私生子迪努瓦以及阿朗松公爵，你知道的，大家记忆中的公爵最大支持者。

sentences.en: They'd all given evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们都提供了证据。

sentences.en: Of course, one person who had not given evidence was another of her comrades in arms, Gilles de Ray,
sentences.zh: 当然，有一个没有提供证据的人是她的另一个战友吉尔·德·雷——

sentences.en: the Breton guerrilla leader, and that was because he had been executed in 1440 on a charge of heresy
sentences.zh: 这位布列塔尼游击队领袖，那是因为他在1440年因涉嫌异端，

sentences.en: and of raping and murdering, and I quote the charge sheet, 140 or more children.
sentences.zh: 以及——我引用起诉书的话——强奸和谋杀140多名儿童而被处决。

sentences.en: Yeah, not a good guy.
sentences.zh: 是的，不是个好人。

sentences.en: He's an embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 他是一个令人尴尬的存在。

sentences.en: The veil is drawn over him.
sentences.zh: 对他讳莫如深。

sentences.en: So what's the verdict of the judges?
sentences.zh: 那么法官们的裁决是什么？

sentences.en: They announced that Joan's original conviction had been invalid, that it had been delivered corruptly, deceitfully, slanderously, fraudulently, and maliciously.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布贞德最初的定罪无效，那是通过腐败、欺诈、诽谤、欺骗和恶毒的方式作出的。

sentences.en: And of course, this not only redeems Joan's own reputation, it also confirms that Charles's coronation in Gros had indeed been ordained by God.
sentences.zh: 当然，这不仅洗刷了贞德的名誉，也证实了查理在兰斯的加冕确实是上帝的旨意。

sentences.en: And so Joan is no longer condemned as a heretic, and she can be inscribed in the annals of French history as the country's greatest heroine.
sentences.zh: 因此，贞德不再被判为异端，她可以作为该国最伟大的女英雄被载入法国历史史册。

sentences.en: And it is a position that she has held ever since, right the way up to the present day.
sentences.zh: 这也是她自那以后一直保持到今天的地位。

sentences.en: And next week, in a special bonus, we will be exploring that legacy.
sentences.zh: 下周，在一期特别的彩蛋节目中，我们将探讨这一历史遗产。

sentences.en: And of course, if you want to hear that, you know what we've got to do, you've got to go to therestishistory.com and sign up there.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你想听那个，你知道我们得怎么做，你得去 therestishistory.com 并在那里注册。

sentences.en: But Dominic, before we leave, we have one last duty to perform, and that is to pay tribute to a hero of France, whose achievements have been, if anything,
sentences.zh: 但是多米尼克，在我们离开之前，我们还有最后一项职责要履行，那就是向一位法国英雄致敬，他的成就——如果说有什么不同的话——

sentences.en: even greater than those of Joan of Arc.
sentences.zh: 甚至比圣女贞德还要伟大。

sentences.en: And who is this paragon?
sentences.zh: 这位杰出的人物是谁呢？

sentences.en: So this is somebody else who came from a very obscure background, Tom, and rose to tremendous heights and dreamt of by his peers.
sentences.zh: 这是一个同样出身极其卑微的人，汤姆，他达到了惊人的高度，超越了同龄人的梦想。

sentences.en: He too has spent years hearing voices, not the voices of St. Catherine and St. Margaret,
sentences.zh: 他也曾多年听到声音，不过不是圣凯瑟琳和圣玛格丽特的声音，

sentences.en: but rather more cheerfully, our voices, because this person is Theo Youngsmith, our producer.
sentences.zh: 而是更令人高兴的我们的声音，因为这个人就是我们的制作人西奥·扬史密斯（Theo Youngsmith）。

sentences.en: So he has produced, at my count, at least 450 episodes of The Rest Is History since he joined the show at the end of 2022.
sentences.zh: 自我加入节目以来，据我统计，他已经制作了至少450集《历史其余部分》。

sentences.en: He has run recordings in Ireland, in France, in the Netherlands, in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
sentences.zh: 他在爱尔兰、法国、荷兰、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那主持过录音。

sentences.en: He's run several live tours of the United States and Australia.
sentences.zh: 他还在美国和澳大利亚组织了几次现场巡演。

sentences.en: He's taken us to New York, to Los Angeles, to Disneyland, and to the Sydney Opera House.
sentences.zh: 他带我们去过纽约、洛杉矶、迪士尼乐园以及悉尼歌剧院。

sentences.en: He's taken The Rest Is History to heights we would never have dreamed of when he joined the show.
sentences.zh: 他把《历史其余部分》带到了我们刚加入节目时做梦也想不到的高度。

sentences.en: He's been a great friend and comrade to us.
sentences.zh: 他一直是我们极好的朋友和同志。

sentences.en: He is a credit to Scotland, to France, and, of course, to Wellington College.
sentences.zh: 他是苏格兰、法国以及当然还有惠灵顿公学的骄傲。

sentences.en: And, Tom, he will leave.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，他要离开了。

sentences.en: He's moving to spend more time with his Nintendo Switch.
sentences.zh: 他要腾出更多时间去陪他的任天堂 Switch。

sentences.en: And he will leave very, very, very big shoes to fill.
sentences.zh: 而且他留下的空缺将非常、非常、非常难以填补。

sentences.en: So we are tremendously grateful to Theo, aren't we, for the last three years?
sentences.zh: 所以我们对西奥过去三年的工作感激不尽，不是吗？

sentences.en: We are so grateful and we are, you know, we're not a little gutted that he's moving on because
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激，而且老实说，对于他要离开，我们感到非常沮丧，因为

sentences.en: he has been so influential on this podcast, has played such a crucial role in its success.
sentences.zh: 他对这个播客产生了如此深远的影响，在其成功中发挥了至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: And he will, this is not the last we will be hearing of from Theo because he will be coming on a bonus in due course where he will talk to him about everything he's done with the
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是我们最后一次听到西奥的声音，因为他将在适的时候参加一期彩蛋节目，届时他将谈论他在《历史其余部分》中所做的一切，

sentences.en: rest of his history and perhaps he will tell us what his plans are.
sentences.zh: 也许他会告诉我们他的计划是什么。

sentences.en: Because, to be honest, they are as yet opaque.
sentences.zh: 因为老实说，目前它们还不明朗。

sentences.en: He will also.
sentences.zh: 他还会。

sentences.en: So about six months ago, he began work on the famous Stones bonus, the Rolling Stones bonus, in which he claimed he was piling up books in his garret.
sentences.zh: 大约六个月前，他开始着手制作著名的滚石乐队彩蛋节目，在节目中他声称自己正在阁楼里堆砌书籍。

sentences.en: And the Stones bonus has never materialised, basically because he's been too busy working on the show.
sentences.zh: 而滚石彩蛋节目却迟迟没有推出，主要是因为他一直忙于制作节目。

sentences.en: But finally, admittedly, very belatedly, the Rolling Stones bonus will finally materialise.
sentences.zh: 但最终，尽管承认有些迟到，滚石乐队的彩蛋节目最终还是会推出的。

sentences.en: So that's something for everybody to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 所以这是大家可以期待的事情。

sentences.en: So two bonuses to come with Theo.
sentences.zh: 所以还有两个关于西奥的彩蛋节目等着大家。

sentences.en: One where he talks about himself, which he'll enjoy, and one where he talks to Dominic about the Rolling Stones, which I think he will also enjoy.
sentences.zh: 一个是他谈论自己的，他会很享受；另一个是他和多米尼克聊滚石乐队的，我想他也会很享受。

sentences.en: So everybody, thank you very much for listening.
sentences.zh: 所以各位，非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Tom, thank you for four splendid episodes.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，感谢你带来这精彩的四期节目。

sentences.en: And above all, Theo, thank you for everything.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，西奥，谢谢你所做的一切。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
